grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/mtshams sbyor/de yang 'dzam gling go la zlum po'i yang rtse ru rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par 'phags pa'i bsil ldan kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon byon gyi chos rgyal lo paṇa dag gis snyingastobs dang / tshe srogazungs khrag bcas kyis bskrun pa'i shul bzhag gangs can bod kyi rig gnas zhes grags snyan sprin gyi rol mos phyogs kyi 'khor lo 'geng pa'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas ni/ mchog gsum la skyabs su 'dzin cing las 'bras la blang dor byed pa'i chos ldan bod mi yongs kyi snying nor gzhal du med pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ sa chen po'i khyon 'dir gnas pa'i skye dgu thams cad kyi lam ston gyi sgron me nyag gcig tu grub kyang / bar skabs su lo rgyus kyi 'pho 'gyur sna tshogs pa'i dbang gis bla na med pa'i shes rig de dag la nyams gud tshab chen byung ba ni snang ba la gnyen du 'dzin pa'i gangs can bod pa tshos gtso bor byas pa'i skye 'gro spyi yi bde skyid la god chag chen po thebs pa yin pas/ de dag nyams pa sor chod dang / mi nyams gong spel byas nas mes po tsho'i mdzad 'phrin skyong rgyu ni/ sha dang rus pa'i gdung rus gcig las chad cing phug bsam dang mdun lam la gom kha mnyam du phyogs pa'i gangs ljongs gzhon skyes yongs la ma bgos phrag tu babs pa'i 'os 'gan zhig red/ der brten 'dir yang mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa la mkhyen rab kyi spyan dkyus mchog tu yangs shing / rang rigs dang de'i shes rig la dung zhen shin tu zab pa'i na gzhon rtsom pa po rab brtan dge legs phun tshogs mchog gis dpal rab brtan dgon gyi mkhan rin po che thub bstan 'phel rgyas mchog gi rnam par thar pa thar 'dod bung ba 'gugs pa'i skyed tshal zhes bya ba ljags rtsom mdzad pa ni/ rang rigs kyi rig gzhung dkar dmar sna tshogs pa'i chu skyes bkra ba'i khrod du ser chen me tog gcig gsar du

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/'bus pa yin pas/ dam chos sbrang rtsi'i bcud la gcig tu sred pa'i blo ldan rkang pa drug pa'i tshogs kyis dga' spro'i 'phur lding dang bcas te nyams su bzhes rigs la/ lhag tu rtsom pa pos/ gang gis thos bsam bsgom pa'i gru chen las/ /rnam grol mi gnas thar pa'i gling mchog tu/ /mngon par gshegs pa'i sngon byung ngo mtshar gtam/ /dus 'dir nub la nye tshe bdag yid phangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yid bzhin nor las lhag pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di nyid nub la nye ba thugs kyis ma bzod nas/ sku tshegs dang 'o brgyal la ma 'dzem par bgrang bya lnga drug tsam gyi ring la rgyus yod mi sna la bcar 'dri byas te/ bsreg bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin brtag dpyad legs par mdzad nas khungs ldan gyi rigs rnams yi ger bkod pa yin stabs yid ches kyi gnas su bzung chog la/ khyad par dpal sa skya pa'i zab lam khyad par can la brten nas/ nyams dang rtogs pa/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul sogs thun mong dang thun min gyi dngos grub yongs risu brnyes te tshe lus gcig la khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po'i rgyal sa mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul bstan yod pas/ chos dang brgyud pa la dad pa dang nges shes khyad par can zhig 'dren nges pas snying thag pa nas rjes su yi rang zhu rgyu dang 'brel mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus 'di nyid lugs gnyis kyi 'brel pa shin tu zab pa'i khrom thal ba 'jam dbyangs yon tan rgya mtshos spyi lo 2006lo'i zla ba 2pa'i tshes 21la dgon chen bshad grwar bris pa dge

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/thog mar bltam nas gsan sbyong gnang tshul/na mo gu ru badz+ra dh+wa ra mu ne+e shā sa na dzuṣ+ṭi bṛd+dhi ye/rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang po'i lung rtogs bstan / /rnam ku+on 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mthu grub pa/ /rnam gral lam stan dpal ldan bla ma la/ /rnam dag sgo gsum gus pas phyag bgyi'o/ /bde chen chos sku'i klong las 'gyur med kyang / /sna tshogs gzugs sku'i bkod pa 'byams klas pa/ /e waṃ zung 'jug bcom ldan he badz+raḥ/ /'bral med snying gi pad+mor rtag tu bzhugs/ /'jigs rung srin po khros pa'i rngam stabs kyis/ /khro tshogs gzhan gyi lag cha brul byed pa/ /'jigs mdzad khro rgyal badz+ra bhe ra was/ /gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol bar mdzod/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ / rnam snang chos kyi dpal mo la sogs pa/ /

dge legs 'dod 'dzo'i dpe tshogs/yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dad brgyas bsnyen/ /rgyal kun mthu stobs nus pa'i spyi gzugs che/ /ye shes spyan ldan dam can srung ma yis/ /bla mas bcol pa'i bka' la nyer dgongs nas/ /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs mdzod kye/ /'di na 'phags chen blo yi ra ba las/ /'gong pa'i dpal ldan bla ma'i bi mo k+ṣaḥ/ /cung zad brjod pa'i skal bzang thob pa yang / /sngon smon rnam dkar mthu yi 'bras buranges/ /de phyir zhi bsil thar pa'i mkha' dbyings la/ /'phur 'dod blo gsal rkang pa drug pa'i tshogs/ /mgron du 'gugs pa'i rtogs brngod skyed mos tshal / /rnam dpyod nyi ma'i zer gyis 'gyed par bya//de la 'jam dpal dpal bo'i rigs sngags 'dzin pa'i mthu stobs rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po/ zab gsang snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin rab brtan gzig sgang mkhan chen grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas mchog gi rnam par thar pa 'u cag ltos bcas rnams kyi dad pa'i gsos su bkod pa la don gsum ste/ thog mar bltams nas gsan sbyong gnang / /bar du bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad/ /tha mar dgongs pa rdzogs tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ dam pa'i skye phreng brgyud mar bzhes nas zhing 'dir bltams pa dang / mdo rgyud rig gzhung rgya mtsho la gsan sbyong mdzad cing sdom gsum gyis rgyud gtams tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rgyal tshab ma pham pas/ ji bzhin yang dag mthong ba'i phyir/ /skye sogs rnams las 'dasi gyur kyang / /snying rje'i bdag nyid skye ba dang / /'chi dang rga dang na 4

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/ba ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa nyid kyis bskal pa mang po'i gong rol nas skye 'chi spros pas dben pa'i dbyings ye gnyis med kyi rang don don dam chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du mdzad zin na'ang / ji skad du/ thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /dzil pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po 'gro la rjes su chags pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa rnams su ngo mtshar sprul pa'i rol gar bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa gor ma chag la/ khyad par che mchog bzhi ldan gyi bla ma rwa lo rdo rje grags pa'i skye mtha' nyid du yongs 'dzin zhabrul zad du ma'i rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa ltar yongs la grags shing / 'di la'ang rwa lo dang 'jigs byed kyi chos skor la rtsis chen gnang zhing gtum drag gi las la 'phrin las myur ba dang / lhag lha kun las gshin rje nyid rtsal 'don mdzad cing de'i las tshogs la phyag bzhes mkhas pa sogs kyis rgyu mtshan zhig kyang mchis par mngon/ 'jam mgon chos kyi blo gros kyis 'phan po nā len+d+ra'i sprul sku yin pas dbus su phebs na 'gro don che tshul gsungs pa rab bla dharma'i mtshan can gyis gsan cing / gzhan yang sgo phu go che dgon pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i rnam rol yin pa'ang / zhal snga nas/ nga la legs pa rdo rje 'chang gis khyod sgo phu dgon zhig dgon pa'i sprul pa'i sku'i yang sprul yin pa'i mtshan ma byung bas/ dgon de nyams gso mjad na 'phrin las rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i lung bstan yod kyang de ltar grub ma song zhes gsungs pa kam lha bu g.yang gis gsan 'dug go//de dag gis mtshon te bstan 'gro'i dpal du mkhas grub kyi skyes bu zam ma chad pa'i sku skye bzhes pa'i mthar thun mong gdul bya'i snang ngor zhing 'dir srid pa bzung ba'i yab ni/ gzig sgang bla ma mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal mnga' ye shes blo gros kyi mched ya byams pa dang / yum rta mkhan ngag dbang bsod nams kyi lcam mo rta mgo bkra rdog gi spun ya ma bkra shis 'tsho gnyis kyi sras su mdo khams sde dge'i chos rgyal chen po'i chab 'og rab brtan kam pa shog drug las gzig gtso bor byas

dge legs 'doda'ardza'idapetshogs/ da pa'i gcan gzan mang bas gzig nang zhes grags shing / de la phu mda' srib sgang bzhir phye ba'i nang tshan gzig sgang zhes pa'i grong pa na chags pa'i zos tshang gi khyim gyi 'og khang na/ bla ma mchog nas nga 'di'i rtsa ba nas skyes pa yin gsungs nas gsol mchod gnang ba'i dge bsnyen zhes grags pa'i rdo zhig yod cing / de la gnas bcas nas sdod pa'i g.yag kham pa zhig skabs 'gar mthong rgyu yod pa byung / rdo de'i rtsa bar phru mas sku la chos gos gsol ba'i rnam pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos du ma dang bcas te rab byung bco lnga pa'i kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi ba'i lor gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i nyi gzhon gsar du bzhad pa'i tshul bstan to/ /sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rigs la gnas pas nyam thag pa'i 'gro la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang / 'khor ba la nges 'byung sogs rtsol med du mnga' zhing / btsun pa'i rang tshugs bzung nas gdangs dbyangs rnga rol sogs kyi stangs ka byed pa la mkhas pa zhig yod ces grags/ gzhan yang thugs kyi dgongs don thams cad rang byung lhun gyis grub cing / sga stod du bla ma legs pa'i rtsar phebs nas dre'u dpal thang du zhag bzhugs skabs/ jag chen zhig byung bar mgon 'dis rdzig rdzig btang zhing pho shed ngom pas bcom ma nus pa sogs bya ba lam 'gro yong ba sha stag ste/ nga rang lo na gzhon dus klung rta dar ches pa'i rgyus bya ba gang brtsams lhun gyis grub pa dang / gzhan dang 'khrugs pa bgyis tshe rgyal kha thob pa las yod ma myong zhing / grwa sar 'gro dus zing 'khrugs byung ste gzhan dang 'thab skabs chos grogs tshos khyod kyis 'phangs pa'i rdo las me stag 'tshub 'dug zer ba byung zhes bka' bstsal bar mdzad/ de dag gis ni dam pa'i skye ba brgyud mar bzhes nas zhing 'dir zhabrungs tshul dang / chung nas dam pa'i che ba la gnas tshul gyi rim pa phyogs tsam bshad pa yin no/ /med byung yon tan tshogs kyis mngon mtho ba'i/ /dam pa'i skye phreng brgyud mar bzhes pa yis/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid pad+ma dkar po'i tshal /6

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/rgyas phyir lung rtogs chos kyi gru char bsnyil/ /khyad par ljongs 'di'i gdul bya'i shar ri'i rtser/ /mtshungs med thugs bskyed rlung gi mgyogs 'gro yis/ /drangs pa'i rgyal sras nyi ma gzhon nu'i zer/ /srid pa'i mun pa 'phrog pa'i dpal du shar/ /de tshe phal pa'i blo las yongs 'das pa'i/ /ngo mtshar ltas bzang cho ga du ma yis/ /rab 'byams zhing kun khyab pa'i grags snyan gyi/ /chos dung dkar mos rang sgra 'byin 'di rmad/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgyal kun mkhyen rab dmar ser dhīḥyi khams/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs kyi rol pa lhag pa'i lhas/ /sngo bsangs ral gri mkha' la gdengs tsam gyis/ /me+ongs pa'i drwa brgya gcod pa'i shes rab stsol/ / gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba bsam mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'byung ba brgya lam ste/ /mi yi lus kyang tshogs kyis rnyed pa yin/ /kye ma dad pa dang ni chos nyan pa/ /'di 'dra bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par dka'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i nyan 'chad byed pa ni srid na 'gran gyi do zla ma mchis pa'i nor bu mchog cig yin la/ dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir du thun mong dang thun min gyi sde snod rin po che rnams la gsan bsam gyi brtson pa cher bskyed pa'i tshul bstan cing / yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos thos pa'i gsan yig cig bzhugs nges na'ang / deng sngon lag son ma byung bas zhib tu 'bri rngo mi thogs mod kyi phyogs tsam 7

dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dpe tshogs/brjad na/dgung lo bdun gyi thog khu bo bla ma ye blo'i mdun nas yig dkar nag 'bri klog bslab pas dka' tshegs med par mkhyen/ dgung lo bdun par rab brtan dgon gyi tshogs la zhugs te dgon gyi ma/khan po dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes nas bslab gzhi rnams la gces spras kyis srung sdom mdzad/ dgon gyi cho ga dang chos spyod blor 'dzin dargo/sa pa rnams thugs la bzung ste tshogs rgyugs legs par phul bas kun gyis bsngags brjod dang gzeng bstod bcas rgya cher gnang / lo na bcu gcig la son pa na sngar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsol ba'i mkhan po nam mkha'i mtshan can dang kha skong gi dge 'dun grangs tshang ba las / thub pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ste mtshan la dpal 'byor bzang po zhes su gsol/gzhan yang rje de las smin grol man ngag gi skor mang du gsan cing mgon des thugs rtsis che ba mdzad pas/ bdag lha gral du tshud tsam byung ba 'di skyabs rje nam mkha'i mtshan gyi sku drin yin gsungs nas bka' drin che ba'i tshad du 'dzin/ lo tshad la sleb pa na seng sgang mkhan po snyan grags rab rgyas sogs dang lhan du dam pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes ltar yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan du phebs te/ rgyal bas lung gis bsngags pa'i rtsod dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i chos khri la bzhugs pa'i mkhan rin po che 'jam dbyangs thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog dang / las slob sogs grangs tshang ba'i drung nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes shing / mtshan du thub bstan 'phel rgyas zhes pa'i cod pan gsol/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras tshogs bshad kyi smin grol man ngag dang bcas pa sogs sdom gsum gyi chos bka' mang po dang /gzhan yang sa ngor gyi dam pa rnams las chos 'brel ci rigs pa gsan nas de dag gi gnang bkag gi gnas la srung sdom zhib par mdzad/ slar rang yul du phebs nas mtshan ldan bshes gnyen du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te gsan sbyong gnang ba'ang / rnying ma'i mkhan po ngag chung gi dngos slob spo lu ba spo

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/mda' mkhan po rdo rje las/ dkar nag rtsis sogs rig gnas kyi skor du ma dang / mkhas dbang kun bzang bsod nams kyi nye gnas rdzogs chen mkhan po a dpal gyis dgun dpyid dbyar gsum na mdo dgon khag gsum du zab rgyas chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba'i skabs/ myur ba ngag dbang bstan 'dzin dang lhan nas sor mdo dang / spyod 'jug dbu ma rtsa 'jug kye rdor mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung skor du ma bcas la gsan sbyong dam por mdzad de thugs su chud/rdzong sar khams bye'i slob grwa chen mor zhugs te mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rab 'byams gzhung brgya smra ba'i mkhas dbang dbon stod mkhan chen mkhyen rab chos kyi 'od zer zhes grags pa'i mdun nas/ bgrang bya lnga'i ring la mdo sngags gzhung chen bzhi bcu'i skor la gsan bsam gyi brtson pa cher bskyed de/ thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin par mdzad pas nyid kyis thugs sras gcig tu 'dzin/ rab 'byams rgyal ba yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs/ mkhyen sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam dbyangs chos kyi blo gros kyi zhabs pad gtsug tu mchod de rje de nyid las/lam 'bras slob bshad dang / sgrub thabs kun btus/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang brgya rtsa/ gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha dgu bcas kyi smin grol man ngag lung dang bcas pa sogs snga rjes su zab chos mang po gsan te thun min nang gi rigs bdag gcig tu gyur/ 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i gdung 'tshob sga ston rdo rje 'chang legs pa rin po che sga khog tu bzhugs pa'i mdun du snga rjes thengs gnyis la phebs nas zab chos mang du zhus mdzad cing / de la sngon ma dgung grangs so bzhi bzhes pa chu bya lor seng sgang snyan grags rab rgyas dang mgo gus bstan 'dzin chos ldan gnyis dang lhan du khal a yu zhig la gsol chas bkal nas byon te/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa slob bshad kyi smin grol lung dang bcas pa cha tshang dang / khrid kyi skabs su dka' gnad khag la 'grel bshad kyang mdzad de shin tu rgyas spros kyis bka' chos zla ba drug la bstsal ba dang / de'i rjes su yang phebs te mgon po bka' babs bzhi'i

dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dpe tshogs/dbang rjes gnang phyi nang gsang ba'i khrid sogs gsan par mdzad/ mthu stobs nus pa'i dpal mnga' mkhan rgan ngag dbang bsam gtan blo gros las/ snga rjes su sgrub btus dang / 'jigs byed rwa lugs thun mong dang thun min gyi smin grol dang rwa pod bcas zab rgyas/ kye rdor rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa shin tu rgyas pa/ nyid kyi rtsom chos skor mang che ba'i lung sogs dang / sku tshe gser dgon du sdom brtson yongs kyi thu bo bla ma 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan las/ lam 'bras rnam 'grel bcu gnig gi lung khrid sbrags ma sogs 'dod chos kha shas/ gsang bdag blo gter 'khas kyi thugs sras ho bla dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gzig phur yun ring bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i dbang khrid pod lung sogs chos skyong gi chos skor mang po dang / zhal shes man ngag gi rigs yongs rdzogs/ lnga rig smra ba ye na gyod sprul 'jam dbyangs thub bstan rgyal mtshan las/ zab mo gcod kyi dbang lung dang / lha bsang khrus chog ma'i lung / gzig sgang ri khrod du dgon chen nub bla ma kun bzang chos 'phel ched du phebs pa las/ mkhan po sher 'byung dang gnyis kyis zhal rnal 'byor bcu bdun gyi rjes gnang dang gsang khrid/ zhal pod gnyis kyi lung sogs chos bka' du ma/ stag gzig āḥyu mkha' 'gro las/ grub chen nā ro ta pa'i thugs bcud rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i smin grol bcas gsan mdzad cing / gzhan yang bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams dang / ye na thub bstan chos 'phel rab rgyas/ 'phred bla rta mgrin mtshan can/ mdo srib thub bstan rgyal mtshan sogs las kyang chos 'brel ci rigs bzhes pas mtshon te/ mdor na ris su ma chad pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa du ma'i zhabs rdul gus pas blangs nas thun mong ba mdo rig gnas dang bcas pa la gsan bsam dbyis phyin par gnang la/ de bzhin du rgyud sde chen po bzhi drug dang 'brel ba'i thun mong ma yin pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol rgyab brten cha lag dang bcas pa dang / lhag tu bskyed rdzogs man ngag gi rim pa dang / zhal shes snyan brgyud kyi yig chung sogs mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu'i zab la dkon pa'i gdams skor bcas rdzogs par bzhes mdzad de/ bka' las kyang / nga'i mgo thog tu 10

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/dbang rdzas mang por 'jog myong zhing / rna bas chos mang du thos myong bas 'di gnyis rtsa chen yin zhes gsungs la/ gang thugs gter gyi bum pa 'dzad med lung dang rtogs pa'i nor gyis gtams pa'i mdzod chen po gcig tu gyur to/ /dge legs kun gyi gzhi gyur so thar gyi/ /sdom pa skya rengs dang po'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /nyes lhung mun pa pha mthar bskrad dang lhan/ /ngur smig rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs bzhes/ /srid zhi'i yams nad 'phrog la ches dpa' ba'i/ /rnam dag byang chub sems kyi a skṛ tas/ /gang thugs yol go phyur bur gtams pa'i mod/ /sems dpa' gzhan rnams brtson pa lhod kyis dwogs/ /mtshan rtog rnyog ma mtha' dag bgrung byed cing / /mchog thun dngos grub lag rtser smin byed pa/ /gsang chen gdams pa'i rin chen ke ta ka /gang gi gsang gsum mdzes pa'i dpal du gyur/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/bar du bstan 'gro'i don chen mdzad tshul/rtsod ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ /'dul la bde gshegs gzhan las yongs bsngags pa/ /smon lam lnga brgya'i mthu grub bcom ldan 'das/ /rnam 'dren don kun grub pas dge legs stsol/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ bshad dang sgrub pas bstan 'gro'i don ji ltar mdzad pa dang / grub pa'i mtshan ma sna tshogs brnyes pa'i tshul/ dbus su phebs nas gdul bya 'dul ba'i mdzad pa lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos nga brgyad ma las/ thog mar shes bya kun la mkhas par bya/ /bar du mkhas pa'i tshogs su legs par bshad/ /phyi nas 'dris pa'i don la brtson pas bsgom/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi bzhed gzhung yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mtshan ldan mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs pad bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas legs par bsten cing / zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi ngom med du bzhes par mdzad la/ de'ang thos rkyang tsam du ma bzhag par rang don du bsgoms pas nyams su blangs shing skal ldan gzhan la 'chad spel gnang ba ste/ de'i tshul ni 'phred blas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa mdzad de grub pa'i go 'phang mngon sdu mdzad pa'i gnas mchog 'phred mo bde chen ltem gyi mtshams khang dang / dgon pa'i nang sogs su dgon gyi spyi sgrig 'byung 'dul gyi mtshams dang / dpal kye rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen rgyas pa/ sa 'jam sbags sgrub dang / kun rig nye brgyud tshe rta zung 'brel/ skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin/ khyung khra/ mkha' spyod/ ngor 'jigs/ phur pa/ brag rdzong ma sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub la bzhugs nas bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'gro bar 12

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/mdzad/ 'phred bla dang lhan du lcags ra 'jigs byed khang du byon te/ lo gcig la tshar 'jigs las gshin dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa bsags mdzad cing/ 'phred bla byon kha'i zhal bzhes ltar bsam yas pa'i bkod pa dang bcas zhing du gshegs pa'i gdung la mchod 'bul dang / dgongs rdzogs bcas rgyas par bsgrubs zhes thos/ bar skabs su thugs cung mi bde ba zhig byung ba'ang / khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i sku mtshams la bzhugs te gtor bsngo mdzad pas rang zhir song zhing / des na da ltar dgon pas bskang gso'i tshe phyag rdor gyi gtor bsngo'i dbur rta mgrin la gtor bsngo mdzad pa'ang bla ma nyid kyi phyag bzhes kyi rgyun skyong ba yin no/ /snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen 'jam mgon dharma ma tis bka' phebs byung ba dang / sde dgon yongs kyi re ba ltar dgung grangs sum cu bzhes pa sa sbrul lo nas dgon gyi chos khri la bzhugs te dbyar gso'i mkhan po dang / sgrub mchod khag gi rdor slob bcas gcig chog mdzad cing / de'i tshe sdom gsum gyi bcas mtshams la 'chol nyog tu spyod pa thams cad sun phyung ste chos mthun gyi sgrig khrims dam par bsdams/ der brten deng dus su'ang bla ma rgan gras tshos mkhan po thub bstan tshogs dbur phebs dus kyi tshogs sgrig dang tshogs brjid lta bu ni kho bo cag gi tshe la mthong thos byung myong med ces gleng mol byed kyin 'dug go/ /dbyar gnas kyi dus su dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs la lo re mos kyis sor mdo dang / spyod 'jug sdom gsum rab dbye/ sdom gsum 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dgongs rgyan/ kun rig rnam bshad sogs kyi chos khrid zhib rgyas dang /bya rgyud tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang chen dang / seng gdong rigs lnga dang / lo gyon ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang / 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi dbang / tshe dbang sogs lhag lha du ma'i rjes gnang rig gtad bsgom lung sngags btu sogs dang / bsang bskang sogs 'don chog skor mang che ba'i lung bcas gnang zhing /bsang rgyag brngan gyi lung gnang ba'i tshe kho bos mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bsam blo las 'di'i lung mnos pa'i skabs/ thub bstan khyod kyis 'di nyid gsungs sa gang rnyed byas nas gsungs rogs gyis dang / nga la nye brgyud byas na mi chog pa med pa'i lung zhig yod ces gsungs pas khyed cag gis lung 13

dge legasa'adod 'do'i dpe tshogs/spel la nan tan mdzod cig gsungs/ dgon du thos bsam rnam grol gling gi slob grwa gsar du btsugs te/ thog mar mdo srib pa thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i ljags lung dang gzhung bshad gnang zhing / de nas bla ma rin po ches mkhan po mdzad de lung rigs smra ba'i slob ma mang po la sum rtags dang / sngags kyi bklags thabs/ nag rtsis sogs rig gnas kyi skor dang / rgyal sras lag len dang / bshes springs/ spyod 'jug sor mdo/ 'dul ba lnga bcu pa dang /sum brgya pa/ dbu ma dang sdom gsum gyi skor/ spyi ljon brtag gsum/ nyi zla zer/ snang rgyud gsum sogs kyi gzhung bshad zhib mor gnang ste skal ldan tsho'i yid gsos par mdzad/ lo bcu song mtshams nas dgongs khrol byung ste gdan tshab tu seng sgang snyan grags rab rgyas brko bzhag gnang / de nas bla ma'i dgongs babs bzhin rang khyim las rgyang grags phyed tsam gyis brgal cing khor yug tu rang byung gi spang ljang sogs kyis mdzes shing nyams dga' ba/ sa dpal bzang la mthun rkyen 'dzoms shing nyams rtogs 'phel ba'i dpal grub pa'i gnas mchog gzig sgang ri khrod gsar bzhengs gnang ste/ sa yos lo nas lo grangs dgu la tshe rabs kyi lhag pa'i lha mchog 'jam dpal rdo rje khros pa ma lha'i zhal can gyi sku mtshams mdzad de/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi yang snying / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gzhan las gnad bcu gsum gyis zab cing / gang zag dbang po yang rab tshe lus gcig la grol ba'i chos/grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa zam ma chad pa las brgyud pa/ dam tshig gi g.ya' yis ma gos la byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal ba'i zab lam bskyed rim phyi nang gi rnal 'byor dang / rdzogs rim rdo rje gsum gyi sgrub pa dang sbrags te snying po yi ge bcu pa dung phyur gcig kha skong dang bcas pa bsags mdzad pas/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob ste 'jigs byed dngos lta bu'i gsal snang byung bar gsungs shing / de'i tshul gzhan yang wa ra mkhan po yon tan seṅge bla ma'i drung du 'jigs byed kyi dbang khrid gsan par phebs nas gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang ba'i tshe/ kho bos gzhan 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang 'dzin skyong spel gsum sogs kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don cher ma 'grub mod/ 'on kyang 'jigs 14

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/byed kyi smin grol thob nas sgrub pa byas te hrīḥṣ+ṭidung gcig song bas/ yul gang la dmigs na rtags ma thon pa gcig kyang med ces dang / nga 'chi dus su shi nyan red phod ma red dam pa'i chos zhes gsungs mdzad pa ltar la/ yi dam de'i sgo nas rtags dang rten 'brel bzang po byung ba'i tshul 'og nas 'byung ngo/ /de nas dgung lo zhe lnga pa sa byi lo'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshe slar yang rdzong sar du phebs te/ mkhyen sprul rdo rje 'chang gis cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu nas nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang /khrid lung sbrags ma/ bcu bzhi la mkhyen brtse gong ma'i dgongs gter mtsho skyes snying thig dang / phur par gnad tig rtsa gsum dril sgrub bcas kyi dbang lung sogs gnang zhing / de'i tshe bum chu dang gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi thod chang thengs gsum la zho ltar du chags song zhes tshe stobs la gsungs/tshes bco lnga bdag cag gi ston pas sku rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis sems can dpag tu med pa dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las grol bar mdzad pa'i dus bzang la ched gtad kyis byang chub sems sdom bstsal te/ thub bstan dri med 'od zer zhes pa'i mtshan gyi cod pan gsol/ bla slob thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur cing / tsan+dan gyi phreng ba rgyan ldan zhig phul nas gdams pa zhig zhus lan du gnang ba'i zhal gdams shig kyang yod/ phyir byon nas rigs kyi bdag po'i bka' lung bzhin rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsnyen sgrub mdzad de oṃ gsum ma dung gcig kha skong gi mar me'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'gro bar mdzad/ dpal sa skya'i bdag chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mchog yum sras rnams mdo smad du phebs skabs/ bla ma la khyed rang dgung grangs lnga bcu baspyes pa na tshe gegs chen po zhig 'dug pas tshe sgrub la 'bad dgos gsungs par/ de'i bzlog rim du sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dus bsnyen zhig bzhugs te/ tshe rgyas pa'i spel tshigs btags nas du ba'i sbyin sreg mdzad pas keg las grol ba'i mtshan ma dang / sgrol dkar rjes gnang skabs shig sgrub khang gi steng nas 'ja' dkar po mdung tshugs su zug pa sogs rtags ngo mtshar ba byung zhing/ gzhan yang zhing skyong gdong bzhi pa'i bsnyen mtshams sogs bzhugs te lo grangs bco brgyad la lhag lha du ma'i sgrub pa 15

dge legs 'dod 'dzo'i dpe tshogs/tshad du bskyal/ de'ang mngon rtogs so so'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor dang sbyar te mtshams sgrub la gzhol bas gzhan gyi bsnyen mtshams las khyad du 'phags shing / thun mtshams rnams su'ang sgo gsum tha mal du mi bzhugs par spang la rdo dkar gyis gzungs sngags bri ba dang / phyag tsha 'debs pa/ dbang bskur zhing chos 'chad pa/ mo rtsisangamadzad pa sogs dge ba'i bya ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /dus rgyun zhal 'don la lta ba zab mo'i rtsi dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas chag med rnam bzhi dang / 'jigs byed/ rta phyag phur pa/ sgrol dkar/ mgon po sogs yi dam mang po'i rgyun khyer dang / gtor ma brgya rtsa rja bha la ser nag dkar dmar dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas pa/ bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i snrogs la gtor bsngo/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu gnyis la mkha' spyod sgrub mchod/ bsngo smon bcas rgya che zhing shin tu brel ba'i dbus gtsang du byon lam du'ang chag med mdzad pa thos so/ /de skabs su 'chad spel mdzad pa la/ rang dgon du ye na mkhan po chos rab kyis lam 'bras kyi smin grol stsol rjes su gzhi byes kyi bla grwa yongs kyi ngor byas te/ lam 'bras slob bshad pod bcu bdun dang/ lha bsang khrus chog ma/ rgyag brngan cha lag dang bcas pa sogs kyi ljags lung dang /'jigs byed rwa lugs lha dgu'i dbang chen dang/ las gshin lha bcu gsum ma'i rjes gnang / rwa lo'i gsol 'debs dang / sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba/ 'jigs chog sogs chos tshan du ma'i lung / go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu dang / rwa rtse sems 'dzin gyi nyams khrid zhag bdun gyi sa bcad mdzad pa bcas bka' drin chen pos bstsal/ de skabs su byung ba'i dngos rdzas rnams dang mar rgya brgya yis gzhir byas te/ dgon du 'jigs chog nyin bdun 'tshogs pa'i rten rtsar gnang / dbon stod pa mkhyen rab chos rje'i bkas bskul te dbon stod slob grwa ru mkhyen rab rin po che dbur bzhugs pa'i bshad grwa ba nyi shu rtsa bdun la 'jigs byed ro lang brgyad skor gyi dbang chen dang / las gshin gyi rjes gnang / rwa lugs kyi spyin sreg dang / rwa lo'i grub rtags gsol 'debs sogs mang po'i lung /'jigs khrid nyin bdun gyi sa bcad mdzad pa shin tu rgyas spros/ sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras 16

grub dbang thub bsnyan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi lung khrid bcas phul mdzad cing / bla slob phan tshun thugs yid gcig 'dres kyis bstod bsngags rgya cher gnang / seng chen gnam brag gnas skor byon dus gnam brag dgon gyi 'dus pa la rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi dbang bskur dang / ri khrod du brag g.yab blo gros rgyal mtshan dang /wa ra mkhan gu ṇa'i mtshan can sogs snga rjes su phebs pa rnams la 'jigs byed kyi smin grol lung sogs gang dgos gnang ba yin zhing / da dung don gnyer can rnams kyi 'dod skong gi phyir du mos bstun gyi smin grol gdams pa'i zab chos mang du bstsal ba nges na'ang / zhib par 'bri rngo mi thogs so/ /dgon du phal cher lo bstar dbyar ljongs rgyu'i dbu bzhugs dang / nyi ldog drug cu'i rdor slob mdzad par phebs shing / gzhan yang dgon sde khag dang bstan sbyin khag tu zhabs rim bsgrub pa dang / nye skor du na shi gal chen byung ba'i skabs sogs su'ang byon te/ so so'i 'dod bstun gyi g.yang sgrub dang / sreg blug dbang khrus/ byad grol/ gshin chog bcas kyis 'gro don mtha' yas par mdzad/sbyin bdag gis phul ba'i dad rdzas rnams kyang dam 'dzin chen pos gsog 'jog med par dgon du tshogs bsngo phul ba dang / yar mchod mar sbyin kho na mdzad pa'i rgyus dgon du grwa khang zhig kyang thon thabs ma mdzad cing / mkhan po'i tshe tshogs pa'i sgrig chas rnams kyang myur ba ngag dbang bstan 'dzin las g.yar po btang dgos pa dang / ri khrod nas gzhan du phebs dus mtshams khang gi sgo rtsid skud cig gis bsdams te byon par grags/ grong chog pa gzhan yin na 'bul ba che chung dang za ma bzang ngan la sems shas che na'ang / rje bla ma 'dis ni dbon stod du phebs dus kho bo grong chog song dus yon 'bul la bsam ngan shar ma myong zhes mkhyen rab mchog la zhus 'dug cing / gsol chas kyang pha zas lu 'bu dkar chung gsungs nas yung sgong btsos pa dang / cho le sogs ngan ngon tsam gyis chog la za ma phal pa yi ga mi 'ong ba ci yang med/ de ltar 'dod chung chog shes 'ba' zhig gis sku tshe 'da' bar mdzad na'ang / 'byor ldan gyi mchog yin pa ste/ bshes springs las/ nor rnams kun gyi nang nas chog shes pa/ /rab mchog lags par lha mi'i ston pas gsungs/ /kun tu chog shes mdzod 17

dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dpe tshogs/cig chog mkhyen na/ /nor mi 'dog kyang yang dag 'byor pa lags/ /zhes dang / brag ra rdo rje 'chang chos kyi nyi mas/ zas gos ci 'byor tsam la chog shes shig thub na/ /phyug po rnam thos bu dang khyad par rang mi 'dug /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /dwangs gsal pad+ma can gyi chu gter la/ /ngang pa'i rgyal po ngang gis 'du ba bzhin/ /skye dgu'i 'dren mchog gang du bzhugs na yang / /skal bzang slob ma'i 'du ba yongs su rgyas/ /mkhyen rab kun gsal bu mo'i lto ba la/ /lung rtogs yon tan chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las/ /'dzad med legs bshad sbrang char sil ma'i rgyun/ /blo gsal blo yi pazla'i dpyid du phab/ /dri med rgyal bstan gangs kyi ri bo'i spor/ /rnam dag lung dang rigs pa'i nga ro yis/ /dregs ldan glang po'i spobs pa 'phrog byed pa/ / dran dbang gdong lnga'i dbang po khyod gcig pu/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i rdul gyis yongs dben pa'i/ /zab yangs mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi a dar shar/ /sna tshogs ting 'dzin sgo mo brgya phrag gzugs/ /ma 'dres gsal bar 'char ba e ma med/ /mi med dben pa'i ri sul nyams dga' bar/ /18

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/zag med dga' bas myos pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /gnyis med mnyam par brdal ba'i 'khor 'das zung / /'gal med bsgom pa'i grags snyan bla na mtho/ /lha gcig 'jigs mdzad ma he zhal can gyi/ /rim gnyista lam la brtan pa thob pa'i mthus/ /sa gsumu 'gro ba'i dpal du gyur pa yis/ /las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i brda rtags rdzogs/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rnam dag byang chub sems kyis rgyud brlan kyang / /thabs mkhas thugs rje'i drag po mngon spyod kyis/ /bsad gso'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i he ru kaḥ/ /rwa chen badz+ra kirtis bdag la dgongs/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gzhung lugs rab 'byams la thos bsam gyis mtha' rgya bcad cing /smin grol gyi gdams pa mang du bzhes pa'i mthar nyin mtshan go sbrel nas rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su bzhes pa dang / bla ma dang yi dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung ba'i mthus mchog thun gyi dngos grub 'grub pa'i mtshan ma mtha' yas pa brnyes te grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa gdon mi za mod/ 'on kyang dam pa 'di nyid sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs te thugs shin tu sgam pas bum nang gi mar me ltar gsang ba srung ba la thugs dam gyi snying po mdzad pas gsungs dka' zhing / gsungs kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i ches shin tu gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa rnams ni/ 'jug pa las/ 'on kyang khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni bsnyad bgyi ma lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rje nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam pa'i ye shes kyi yul las/ bdag 'dra ba'i so skye rang rgyud pa'i rtog yul las 'das shing don du'ang mi 19

dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dpe tshogs/'gyur ba la dgongs pa ste/ de'i tshul mkhan chen mdo srib pa thub bstan rgyal mtshan mchog nas deng song grub rtags thon pa rab brtan mkhan po 'dra ba dkon ces gsungs pas rkyen byas te/ tshe ring stobs ldan nas a zhang khyed la chung dus nas grub rtags mang po yod red gsungs 'dug na de nyid gsungs rogs zhus tshe/ nga la thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam thar mang po yod kyang khyod la bshad rung ba yod ma song / thun mong ba 'di rnams red gsungs nas ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar 'ga' zhig gsungs mdzad pa dang / yang spyir grub rtags zer ba de dang po med pa la yod pa zhig byung / de nas yang mi mngon pa lta bu la slar yod pa zhig byung na 'gyur ba med pa red ces myong ba can gyi gsungs byon pa lta bu'o/ /des na 'dir ni thun mong du gyur pa'i grub pa'i mtshan ma ci rigs pa ston pa rnams mdor bsdus te bkod na/ rab tshes sa yos 1915lor grub mchog dam pa mkhan rgan bsam blo dbus dgon sde mang pos lcags ra ru dmag zlog gi ched du rwa lo'i sbyin sreg blug pa'i tshe rje nyid kyang phebs shing / de'i tshe mkhan rgan gyi zhal nas/ nga'i snying kha nas me stag cig 'phros pa rab brtan dge tshul 'di'i thugs kar thim song bas/ khong 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pa mchog tu gyur pa zhig 'ong rgyu red ces gsungs nas 'byung 'gyur lung bstan gnang ba ltar mngon du gyur cing / de dus nas thugs rgyud kyi rtogs pa 'pho ba'i tshul bstan te rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol bar gor ma chag go/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du bcugs te de'i gdams chos kyi skor lhag lus med pa bstsal cing / de nyid kyi sgo nas rten 'di la mchog thun gyi dngos grub rnam gnyis mngon du 'grub pa'i lung bstan dang dbugs dbyung bcas gnang / de skabs su mi ma yin gyis rin chen dang po'i legs skyes phul ba bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin du spros pa ste/ de'i tshul zhal snga nas/ nga dgon chen du chos zhu yod pa'i nang zhig lam kha'i khang rnal zhig nas khem bu zhig rnyed pa gzan gyis phyi bzhin dbang zhur song bas/ bla mas khri thog nas gzigs te thub bstan khyod kyis ci mdzad yin gsungs byung bar/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas gzigs 'bul zhus pas/ zhib tu gzigs rtog mdzad de sman za byed yag po zhig 'dug 20

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/gsungs/ 'o na bla mas de ltar mdzad par zhu zhus pas dril 'bo'i nang du bcugs song zhing / phyi nyin 'di gser red zer zhing mi ma yin gyis phul ba yin tshod 'dug pas phar bsnams song gsungs kyang /bla ma las maṇ+ḍal gyi dod du phul ba las ci yod zhus pas thugs dgyes nyams mdzad cing / rten 'brel mchog tu dge ba zhig byung song zhes gsungs pa pad+ma rnam rgyal sogs mang pos thos 'dug go/ lhag pa'i lha de nyid thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad de sgrub par yun ring bzhugs shing / rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin nyams su bzhes pas grub pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad de lhag pa'i lha'i dgyes zhal rgyun mi chad pa mjal/ zhal nas kyang / 'jigs byed kyi mtshams grol ba'i nub mo'i snang ba la/ rang gzhan mang pos glang re chibs te gzig sgang nas dpal 'dzum la brgal te song zhing / de'i tshe rang la zhon pa glang nag po zhig 'dug la/ de'i rjes sleb pa dang sha shed dang gzi brjid 'dra ba ni glang gzhan gang la'ang mi 'dug pa'i mtshan ltas shig byung zhes rgan tshe ring stobs ldan la gsungs/ yi dam gyi lha dang ngo bo dbyer mi phyed pa lta bu'i nyams bzang po rgyun du shar zhing / las dag pa'i 'phags pa gzhan la'ang de 'dra'i gzigs snang byung ba ste/ rdzong sar du mkha' sbyod ma'i dbang khrid gsan par phebs nas/ bla ma'i gzims khang du dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gsal snang dang bcas byon pas/'jam mgon mkhyen sprul pa chen pos badz+ra bhe ra wa mngon sum du gzigs gsungs nas bred sngangs dang bcas 'o brgyal zhus par grags la/ bka' las/ phyi nyin dbang gral du nga la nan gyis gzigs nas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra mdzad cing / a la khyod kyis 'jigs byed de shin tu 'grub 'dug da nas mkha' spyod kyi sgrub pa mdzad na chog ces gsungs byung zhes gser ljang mkhan po thub chos la gsungs 'dug la/ de dus su khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku dngos su bstan pa yin gyi red ces mchog sprul kun dga' tshul khrims rgya mtshos gsungs so/ /'jigs byed kyi sgrub pa mdzad nas sku gzugs dang na bza' phyag phreng sogs las me stag che chung mang po 'phro ba dang / dbyar ston gyi tshe ser sprin 'khrigs pa dang chos skyong gi sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus sogs su sgrub khang dmar 'ur gyis 'bar te me'i ḍing po 21

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/gcig tu gyur pa yongs grags la/ skabs shig mtshams khang phyag dar byas pa'i thal lud cig khang ltag tu phos pas de'ang me 'bar 'dug pa byung zhes gsungs/ bla ma la tha mal gyi rnam rtog ldog ste rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor bzhugs pa la dbrog tu med pa'i yid ches kyi nges rnyed byung ba yin no zhes thos la/de'i tshul gzhan yang lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi rje mkhyen sprul pa pad+ma ye shes rdo rje dbus phebs kyi tshe/ 'dren mchog bla ma rin po che yang gnam brag tu chibs bsu byon cing / gter lung las/rin chen brag de'u lung pa'i dbus na yod: :de ru o rgyan 'khor bcas tshogs 'khor byas: :ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi sbrang zhu yod: thes 'byung ba'i rin chen gter gyi de'u'i brag 'og mkhyen kong mchog gsum zhal 'dzom thog zab gter bzhes shul du mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang dang sde btsun 'jam dbyangs dpal mo gnyis byon song tshe/ chu kha na bla mas chab lham phud 'dug pa rje 'dis dbu thog tu bzhes shing ljags kyis ldag par mdzad / mkhyen sprul pas gzigs te thub bstan khyod kyis spyo las de ltar ma mdzad ces gsungs dgos byung ba dang / ri khrod du gung bsang la nyin zhig mtshams khang sgang rgyab brag hrug gdong du phebs nas/ nga la bla ma legs pa'i zhabs dang bsam blo rdo rje 'chang gnyis kyis khyod 'di nas song ste/ mar 'di'i 'bri chu'i nang lcebs shig gsungs na 'di nas song ste chu nang mchong par nges na'ang / chu 'gram sleb dus blo rtse gnyis su 'gyur srid snyam la/ 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse sprul skus de ltar gsungs na the tshom tsam yang med par mchong mi bzhag re zhes gsungs mdzad pa bcas kyis kyang rtogs shing / sku tshe'i smad lha ldan du bzhugs tshe 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse rin po che de da ltar 'dra zhig zhal bzhugs na/ nga ban rgan pus mo btsugs nas rgya dkar nag gang du 'gro dgos byung na'ang 'gro rgyu yin gsungs la/ rgyun du pha bla ma mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang zhes gsungs nas bzod med du spyan chab bsil ba mang ngo / /bstan 'gro'i zhabs rim gyi ched du bcom ldan 'das dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam dpal rdo rje khros pa'i drag po chen po'i sgyin sreg mang du mdzad cing / de'i tshe sogs su snang sems la dbang 'byor te 'khor 'das bden par med pa'i rang mtshang rjen gcer du gzigs pa'i 22

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/lag rjes su rtags khyad par can re ma bstan pa med pas de'i tshul la/ nyid kyi dbon mo tshe dbang lha mo rang yul gyi gzhi bdag dpal 'dzum zer ba sngon yul 'di'i mi mang po gson khrid byas song zhing /phyi nas 'ur co rgyag pa dang gos brdab pa tsam gyis kyang phog thug 'gro ba'i nag phyogs ma rung ba de'i gdon gyis zin te sems rnal du ma gnas par spyo ba'i tshe/ gro khe rtogs ldan o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu byon par ci drag zhus pas/ de nub gsol dgong bzhes te zhal mtshar du ngas kho lcags kyi drwa ba nang bcugs nas khas len byed bcug chog ces gsungs/ mtshan mor de gnas kyi la rtser byon nas gcod 'dul mdzad na'ang / gcod zhabs ma khug nas phyir byon te bla ma khyed kyis ci mdzad na ma gtogs bdag gis thub ma song gsungs/ bla ma thugs rgyal bzhengs te kho dpal 'dzum lcags thod la gsol mchod de tsam byas na'ang da dung ma dga' na thabs yod gsungs shing / phyi nyin tsha mo dang bcas ri rtser byon te phyogs bzhir skyer phur btab/ nyid kyi bgrang phreng dang sku chas nad pa la bskon te 'jigs byed drag chen blug pa na/ mtshams shig tu nad pa nad las grol te a zhang khyod kyis mi rta khyi dmar po de rnams me la ma sregs/ khyod la snying rje med e red ces zer nas bos byung zhing / gzhi bdag de nyid slar yang bka' dam la bzhag ste sbyin sreg gi mjug bsdu bar mdzad/ de nas mtshan ring mor bro rdung glu blangs te 'ur co brgyab na'ang dwogs tsam yang mi dgos pa 'di byung ba snang / mdun ra ru tshang la bar skabs su mi shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs byungaste/ ci drag thog rim gro gang mang byas kyang phan kha ma byung ba na/ pra phab pas pra pa na re/ khyed tshang gi mdun ri 'ba' rgyal jo bo de bud med mtshan ngan dred mo la zhon pa zhig gis bskor ba byed kyin 'dug des gnod pa 'dra zhes zer ro/ /de la bla ma rin po che dgon gyi las tshan rnams dang bcas spyan drangs te/ bzlog rim du zhag bdun la 'jigs byed drag po chen po'i sreg blug rgyas par mdzad/ nyin gsum pa la spor sdes thab tu me sbar ba la ma ltos par me rang 'bar du song ba sogs ya mtshan che bar byung ba kun gyis mthong / bla mas bar chad las grol ba'i dbugs dbyung mdzad cing / mtshan ngan thams cad rang sar zhi bas de nas zhabs tog yang dag par 23

dge legs 'dod 'aro'i dpe tshogs/bsgrubs song zhes mkhan rgan mkhyen snying sogs kyis gleng / ko ko nang hor spang kha tshang la phyugs nad byung nas gnag phyugs mang du shi ba'i dus/ thabs shes gang drag gis rdzas sngags sman sbyor sogs la 'bad kyang bzlog tu ma byung ba na/ bla ma mchog gdan 'dren zhus nas rwa lo'i sbyin sreg blugs pa'i mthus chu bcad pa bzhin de ma thag tu chad pas dad pa dang bsngags brjod rgya cher byas zhes bshad/sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i chu mgo shar dpal spungs dgon du dbon rin po che kame bsam gtan blo gror+sā kyis spyan drangs te/ bstan srid spyi dang bye brag gi sku rim la rwa lo'i drag chen blugs par mdzad/ de'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi thab tshang nas ting nge 'dzin las byung ba'i me rang 'bar du song ba sogs rtags ya mtshan pa du ma byung bas/ der 'dus rnams kyi sems 'phrog ste zhabs tog 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ de nas btegs te dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du byon nas/ de'i rten gtso mkhyen brtse'i dbang po zhabs rkyang gis bod du phebs tshe/ shangs zab bu lunge du byon nas gsol tshigs mdzad dus gter srung gis dngos su phul ba'i sgrol ma'i sku rnying / 'phags rme klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gyi rten yin gsungs nas thugs rtsis chen po mdzad pa/ phyis gter chen mchog gyur gling pa la legs so zhes pa'i gsungs lan gsum byon pa de nyid mjal nas byang chub sems sdom bzhes tshe/rten des bla ma rin po che la mjal dar dang legs so'i zhu rten du sku sgam nas kha btags sngon po zhig gnang ba bla ma'i mgul du babs par/ de nyid rgyun du sku lus dang 'bral med kyis thugs rtsis chen po yod ces sku dbon dkon tshes gsungs la/ bka' las kyang / bdag grwa rogs bzhi dang bcas dpal sbungs yang khrod du song ste/ sgrol ma gsung byon ma'i mdun nas byang chub sems sdom zhig blang skabs/rten sgam nas mdzod rtags shig rlung gis 'phang pa ltar byas nas ske la bsgron byung la/ rlung gis khyer ba e yin na bsam nas rang gzhan tshos bltas dus rlung gi rkyen gyis ni gtan nas min 'dug pas ngo mtshar che ba 'dra byung zhes sga pa tshe stobs la gsungs pa thos/ rab brtan dang leb sgo man gyis bsdu bsgo byas te nag phyogs bdud sde'i dmag bzlog gi ched du thabs shes zab mos rgyas btab ste dgon 24

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/du 'jigs byed drag po'i sbyin sreg mdzad pas/ bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi dpal yon mengs nas 'phrog pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs kyi tshogs rnams rje btsun 'jam dpal rdo rje'i thugs kar gnas spar zhing / 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams dman pa dang kla klo gdug pa'i za kha dar ba'i stobs kyis kha cig thab kyi bang ba'i thog phub mtshams nas shor song ba'i gzigs snang byung zhes dge thub bstan mkhas grub la gsungs pa go/ dpyid ka zhig la than pa chen po byung ste zhing pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i skabs/ rab brtan sde pas bla ma dgon du gdan drangs nas kun dga' ra bar 'jigs byed drag chen blugs mdzad pas/ de 'phral nas char mgo brtsams te zhag bstud mar char chen po rgyun ma chad par babs shing / dpal 'bar phul ma dgos par sprul pa'i me rang 'bar du gyur te thams cad ngo mtshar dad pa'i gnas su bkod ces grags/ lcags yos 1951lor dgon du rgyal 'dre zhugs te de'i gnod pas mi 'dod pa mang po byung la/ lhag tu spang kha kun mchog skal ldan gyis bla ma'i sku tsha 'jam chos shar 'bul du bkums shing / 'phrin las mthar phyin 'gag grir shi ba'i rgyus/ dgon du gshed logs te dri za ldang ches pas grwa khang re'i nang grwa pa mang po ma gtogs re zung byas nas gnas mi nus pa zhig byung ste/ de la bla ma mchog gis dbu mdzad de kun dga' ra ba ru rwa lo'i drag po'i sbyin sreg zhag bdun la mdzad/ mjug bsdu ba'i nyin mor sku la sngags gos phod kha dang / stag sham/mkhyen sprul pas gnang ba'i dbu zhwa byin ldan bcas gsol te tshogs brda btang ma thag nas phebs 'dug cing/ thugs shin tu khros pa'i nyams 'gyur dang bcas bla ma nyid kyis dbu mdzad gnang ste gung bsang zhig kyang ma grol bar sreg blug gnang / nyin mtshan dbyer med par gzugs mi mthong ba'i skad kyis ngu co drag po byed pa dang / bla ma dang mchog gsum yi dam gyi lha bka' sdod dang bcas pa la bden pa bdar nas ling ga la dgra bgegasabakug bstim mdzad tshe/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'thor rlung drag po re byung ste spri mas mchod g.yog zhus nas sku mdun na gnas pa gan rkyal du 'gyel la khad lan mang du gyur cing / 'khor 'tshub byed pa'i rlung nag che chung mang po 'ur sgra dang bcas sgo dang gnam mthong kha 25

dge legs 'dod 'alnga'i dpe tshogs/nas byung ste thab dkyil du thim par mthong/ las sbyar skabs 'gugs gzhug bcing mnyes mdzad tshe ling gas 'phar g.yo drag tu byed pa dang / de la phur pa btab tshe cho nge 'debs pa sogs 'jigs zil cher byung ba der 'dus yongs kyis mthong bas/ tshogs pa thams cad skrag nas 'jigs yol re gyur te gang dgos mi shes pa lta bu dang/ de'i phyi nyin dgon gyi grwa shag thams cad la zhi byed kyi sgo nas me zhags 'phang pa dang / yang nyin yas rdzas shin tu mang bar bsags te rab brtan rka pa shog drug gis bsdu bsgo byas nas rgyal po dkar drug gi mdos chen bcas yod pa sgrub bsngo mdzad de/ dgon zhabs chu kha'i mchod rten nas 'bri chur 'phang pa bcas kyi bka' drin bskyangs / de ltar rkyen bzlog mang du mdzad pas mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar nyer 'tshe'i ltas ngan thams cad rang yal du song ngo zhes der yod rnams kyis gsungs pa bsdur bas thams cad zhal 'cham pa byung/ dbon stod mkhan chen mkhyen rab rin po che rgyal gdon gyis bsnyung nas sku rim ci drag zhus kyang ma phan par/ bla ma rin po che phebs dgos pa'i bka' rgya 'byor te phyi nang byon nas dgong khar dbon stod gru khar thon/ bla mas thugs rgyal bzhes te chab bsil mdzad par rdo hrug nang nas mar gshegs song zhing / de dang mnyam du chu nang nas a che lag dkar zhig gis sbrul zhig bshor nas mthar dum bu gnyis su byas te bsad nas mi snang bar gyur/ phyi nang bsnyung 'dri zhus pas cung yang 'dug gsungs nas sku khams dwangs pa'i tshul ston cing / phar ka'i gru kha na zhabs rjes shig bzhag 'dug zer byung bas/ mkhan chen gyis dpe 'jam blta bar mngags song la/ zhib tu bltas pas sngar nub chab bsil phebs sa'i 'brug rdo che ba zhig la brdzis pa'i zhabs rjes zab tu sor gang lhag can zhig 'dug rwa lo'i drag chen nyin bdun du blugs mdzad pas bsnyun gzhi rim drag tu byung / nyin dang po la ye shes kyi me rang 'bar du song zhing / de'i tshul 'di skad thos te/ de'ang spar byed kyi me ni gdol pa dang dme pho sogs kyis bus pa'i me dgos par gsungs pa bzhin kha 'ju 'ju na phyar g.yab phub nas yod pa'i kha 'ju bsod nams zer ba'i shan pa de la me rgyag bcugs skabs/ bla ma'i sku zil dang khrom mang ches pas skrag nas phar song ba dang 26

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/me mnal shor zhing / kho bo skrag nas 'ur lang ste mchod me las spor sde spar bas mkhyen rab nas se gol zhig btab byung ste/ bltas pas me rang 'bar du song ste thab dkyil nas me 'ur sgra dang bcas 'bar kyin 'dug ces de dus kyi mchod dpon ye na nam mkha' dpal ldan gyis gsungs 'dug de nas mar byon skabs mkhan chen nas gru kha bar skyel ma mdzad cing / 'di nas gru log ste mi rta mang po gri shi red 'dug pas phyin chad de ltar mi 'byung ba'i thugs smon gang zab gnang dgos zhus pa'i tshe/bla mas chu la yun ring por phyag nas gtor zhing bden pa'i smon tshig brjod par mdzad/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi mthus de nas rkyen ngan de nyid rgyun chad de gru log rgol ba ma byung ngo zhes grags/ zhabs rjes de deng skabs rnyed rgyu mi 'dug pa ni chu 'og tu song ba red zer zhing / de dus mkhan po mkhyen rab mchog gis chos ra'i tshogs pa'i nang du rab brtan mkhan po khong sa dang po rab tu dga' ba la gnas tshul gsungs song zhes dgon gsar ngag dbang mkhyen brtses thengs mang gsungs / dbon stod mkhan chen gyi yab tshang ya lha tshang nas nor sgam rkur shor dus bla ma mchog gdan 'dren zhus nas rwa lo'i sbyin sreg blug mdzad de nor sgam rku ma'i skya ke ke zhig dang bha ra ra zhig ste gnyis 'dug pa'i skya ke ke de shor song yang / bha ra ra de khug song gsungs/ ji gsungs ltar mdzod sgam bro sa zer ba'i mi skya ke ke zhig dang / bha ra byed nas 'gro ba'i ja ra gnyis kyis brkus nas thob skal bgos te bro sa bros pas thar song zhing / ja ra sde dger song lam du gla ba shi ba'i ro zhig rnyed pa zos pas pho ba dug ste tshe 'phos pa dang / yang la khar slob grwa tshang gi 'brog 'bangs yod pa'i phyugs zog 'ga' de gnas kyi chom rkun pas brkus song bar/ bla ma mkhyen rab kyis bka' phebs te sbyin sreg mdzad pas mi ring bar rkun ma tshang la na shi rkyen chag ngan pa byung ste bshags sdom mi byed ka med du gyur tshul 'dugagazhan yang phal cher lo bstar bshad grwa'i dus rim la bla ma rin po che gdan drangs nas 'jigs byed drag chen blugs mdzad cing / de skabs su nam mkha' la rgyan dgram pa'i sta gri sogs mtshon cha dang /stag gzig gi pags pa sogs spyan gzigs rnams chad nas lhung 'ong ba dang / thab tshang du khrag gi 27

dge legs 'dod 'alnga'i dpe tshogs/rgyun chen po sil thon gyis 'khyil ba/ thab stegs la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bkrag ma nyams pa rang bzhin gyis sngar las gsal bar byon pa/ thab kyi me tshang dang 'bul gtor la dpal 'bar gyis me spar ba la ma ltos par me rang 'bar du 'gro ba sogs rtags ya mtshan pa re ma byung ba med do zhes dgon gsar bla ma sogs der bzhugs mang pos lan gcig min par gleng / sngon 'byung po stobs chen zhig dang phrad de mang po smyo shi gyur pa'i brag ring sna nas phebs skabs/ khro bo yongs kyi sde dpon dpal chen rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur bzhengs te/ 'byung po de nyid zhabs 'og tu mnan nas bka' dam la bzhag pas rkyen ngan de nyid ming gi lhag mar song ste de nas skye 'gro rnams la 'tshe ba ma byung zhing / de dus su brdzis pa'i zhabs rjes ngo mtshar ba zhig yod ces bshad/ (rjes de phyis su chu log rgyug dus mnan de da ltar mjal rgyu mi 'dug mchan/) hor brag nag tshang nas rim gro bsgrub par gdan drangs te phebs pa na glo bur du bla ma'i dbu klad kyi steng gi bar snang mthon po nas/ gnam rdo lug ro tsam zhig babs byung bas sku 'khor rnams bred cing dpa' zhus pa na/ rje nyid 'ur langs te chibs gong nas rgyal ba yongs kyi mthu stobs kyi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi skur bzhengs shing /rang la 'bab tu cha ba byung ba dang sdig mdzub drag po zhig mdzad pas bzlog ste sa la 'phang pas kun gyi yid rab 'phrog pa byung / de nas mtsho khog ltem du sreg blug rgyas par mdzad cing / de'i tshe nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i klong nas mi min gyi cho 'phrul lam 'grub rtags gang rung lta bus gnam sa ral ba snyam byed pa'i rdir sgra chen po zhig dang bcas rdo rje'i me char chen po zhig nye 'khris su lhung bar gyur/ su la'ang thog sgrib phog pa tsam yang ma byung bas ngo mtshar skyes shing / de skabs dpag tshad mang pos brgal ba'i pha rol na yod pa rnams kyis kyang glog mes khra khyug khyug byas te thog rgyag pa mthong thos byung zhes bka' drin che ba'i mes po thub bstan mtshan can sogs kyis gsungs la/ 'di ni rang snang dbang du 'dus shing bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa'i mtshan ma yin pa ste/ rwa chen grags pa'i mgur las/ mda' mtshon dang rdo yi char phab kyang / /sgyu lus la tshugs pa med pa de/ /nga go zur mkhas pa ma 28

—grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/lags te/ /bskyed rim la myong ba thon pa'i rtags/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /mdo khams kyi gnas chen lnga phrag lnga las yon tan sku'i gnas mchog 'bri gnyan ldong du gnas bskor la phebs te gnas 'dabs nas byon lam du sku ngal gsos te/ phyag g.yon pa rdo zhig la brdab pas phyag rjes shig byung zhing / spyan snga nas/ nga gnyan 'dong gnas bskor song skabs sa gar song zer na 'dir song / las ci las zer na 'di las zer ba zhigi dgos red byas nas lag g.yon pa rdo zhig la bzhag ste/ g.yas pas lag g.yon gyi rjes shig bris shing / khong rnams nas phyag rjes shig dod 'dug zer yang gang yin mi shes zhes tshe stobs la gsungs par mdzad/ mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga'i nang gses yon tan 'phrin las kyi gnas mchog seng chen gnam brag tu gnas 'dus skabs gnas bskor du phebs shing /sngon gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pas brag ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i gong mo 'og ma nas gter bzhes skabs/ sgar btab mdzad pa'i dung la mgo'i spang khug tu bzhugs nas rtsa gsum rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i tshogs la tshogs brgya dang dgon par mang ja'i bsnyen bkur bcas phul bar mdzad/snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes kyi klong du 'byams klas pa'i nyams rtsol med du shar zhing /phyi chul la gro khe rtogs ldan dang rtogs pa rtsal 'gran pa'i zol gyis gnas 'dabs su phyag rjes shig dang/ dbu rtse'i skor lam du phyag rjes shig bzhag mdzad la/ de nyid na ning gnas skor song dus mjal rgyu byung / (gnas 'dabs kyi rjes de ni 'di lo'i ston khar shwa 'od chen po rgyug dus mi mngon pa gyur pa thos nas yid pham pa byung / mchan/)rtse skor 'gro sa'i gnas phug gcig tu phyag rjes shig bzhag song ba slob dpon drin chen thub bstan mtshan can nas gsungs pa thos myong mod/ de dus rang lo na chung stabs zhib 'dri ma shes pas da ltar gang yin cha chod pa ma byung ngo / /ri khrod du bzhugs dus kyi nyin zhig la sbyong phrug rnams khrid de mtshams khang sgang rgyab ye dgon mjal ba'i brag hrug gdong du phebs nas/ nga kha nyin 'dir song tshe ye na dgon pas gso sbyong 'tshogs nas lhung ba phyi bcos gsungs pa'i tshig thams cad thos 'dug pa zhig byung / bag chags 'dra zhig yin gyi red ces gsungs pa sogs 29

dge legs 'dod 'ardza'i dpe tshogs/sngon gyi bag chags sad pa'i rtags bzang po mnga' zhing / rang dgon du 'jigs byed kyi dbang chen gnang ba'i tshe phyi la sku ngal gso nas bzhugs skabs/ 'du khang steng nas phug ron zhig gis skad 'dra min mang po rgyag par/ phug ron ye 'dis hrīḥsgyiḥ'adon 'dug red ang zhes de dus kyi las rdor ye na ngag dbang snyan grags la gsungs pa sogs snang ba thams cad lha sku dang 'ja' 'od yig 'bru'i rnam pa yang yang du shar zhing / sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa dang / dran rtog thams cad ye shes kyi rnam rol du gzigs pa las g.yo ba mi mnga'o/ /gzhan yang spang khar slob ma rnams dang bcas byon nas spang la slob ma rnams gcer nyal byed bcugs te/ bla ma mchog gis mnyam bzhag thengs re mdzad pa dang bya rgod rnams gcig lhung gnyis lhung gis lhung yong ba sogs ting nge 'dzin la mnga' dbang 'byor tshul gyi lo rgyus mang zhing / mtshams khang gi mar 'khris su phyi ba zhig shi ba'i ro las kyang 'ja' 'od kyis gur khang phub pa byung ba sogs skye 'gro rnams 'brel tshad don ldan sha stag tu mdzad do/ /de ltar grub dbang bla ma mchog khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs shing / yi dam gyi lha dang ngo bor dbyer med du gyur pa'i che ba la sku smad la stag ris stag lpags kyi sham thab bgos pa ltar gnas pa rgya dge sogs kyis yang yang mjal 'dug cing spyan gru gsum du dod pa dang / thog sdud byung ba'i sde dge tshang gi mi drag rnams kyis rje 'dis drug cu'i dgongs gsol gsungs pa mjal ba dang bla ma 'di ni nged dgon chen dgon lta bu las dgon sde gzhan gyi mkhan po ma red zer ba byung zhing /mgon po mchog tshogs dbur phebs nas su yang dus min du chab bsil zhig kyang 'gro nus med pa sogs sku zil che ba'i tshad du grags la btsan drag kyang shin tu che bar bshad/ de la mi mkhas pa kha cig gis bla ma thub bstan 'dra ba'i bla btsan ni gang na'ang yod zer nas smod khul ltar byed pa'ang thos la/ de ni sgis bla ngag dbang chos 'phel nas wa ra dam chos bstan pa mchog bla ma mgon po'i ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung zhing / gtum drag gi 'phrin las thams cad mngon du 'grub pa'i rtags su thugs rgyal bzhengs shing thugs thag thung ba ltar byung ba na/ phal cher gyis de'i gnad mi shes par bla 30

grub dbang snyeb bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/ma smyo red zer ba byung zhes 'jam rgyal mchog sprul la gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs par snang ngo / skog gyur gyi chos rnams sgrib thogs bral ba gsal bar gzigs te 'byung 'gyur mngon gzigs kyi lung bstan gnang ba ni/ grong dge 'jam dbyangs blo ldan gyis rab brtan rdzong gi gto bo'i las 'gan zhog rjes wa ra bla ma dam chos bstan pa la bcar te/ kho bos lha gang bsnyen na 'grub thag nye ba dang / 'chi dus blo bde chog pa'i chos shig bka' drin gnang grub par gsol ba btab pas/ khyod rgya mtsho rgyud la bzhag/ ko gyong mchil mas sbang par 'di na ci phyir 'ong / ngas ci mi shes/ mkhan po thub bstan 'phel rgyas mdun song gsungs nas chos 'brel ma thob/ gathig sgang du song ste snyan gseng phul bas/ bla ma rin po che nyid mdo khams 'phrin las 'gro 'dul gyi sprul pa'i gnas brgyad las las kyi rigs kyis 'dul ba'i gnas mchog khra spang brag mjal ba'i mtshams khang gi ltag sgang du phebs nas/ ye na bzhugs pa'i spang brag sgrub rgan rin po che kame mthu stobs mchog khyod kyi tshe rabs las kyi bla ma yin 'dug pas mi ring bar bsten dgos gsungs te mngags/ dbon stod du 'grims nas sgrub rgan rin po che gyang dmar mgon khang du bzhugs pa dang mjal te/ zhu rten du gser phye thum po gcig yod pa bzhag ste rjes su bzung bar zhus pa na/ mgon po 'od dpag med de khyod kyi tshe rabs nas 'brel pa thob pa'i lha ru 'dug des na sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas la snying nas gsol ba thob la 'od mtshan thon gsungs nas bzlas lung zhig gnang / rjes su 'di lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i gnam stong la yar slebs shog dang 'od dpag med kyi dbang zhig 'don rgyu yin gsungs nas btang / khyim du bsdad pas nad babs sngar las je lcir song ste nag zla'i tshes sum cu sangs rgyas stong gi dus chen la tshe ma zin par dus las yol te bde chen zhing du spar ba we na bya bla 'jam bkras gsungs pa dang / yang gzig sgang ri khrod du bzhugs dus nang zhig tu slob ma rnams la de ring za ma snang mi gtsang ba zhig khur 'ong rgyu red gsungs/ de nyin gzig phu tshe dpag 'tsho nas zho zo ba gang khyer byung la/ snang mi gtsang ba ni 'jam chos gsod rtsa bud med 'di la thug pas de la dgongs pa 'dra zhes gleng / dus 'gyur gyi tshe bla ma 31

dge legasa'adod 'dze'i daspre tshogs/mchog dbus phyogs su phebs kha ru shul lus rnams nas mjal phyag gi rten dang bcas te/ bla ma rin po che slar rang yul du phebs thub e 'ong zhus pas/ rten 'di la pha yul du 'byor gyi ma red/ 'ong skabs 'dra byung na'ang de dus ngas dril bu dkrol mtshams dang ting shag brdung mtshams zhog 'gro red/sde dgon gnyis nas nga rang yul du gdan drangs yin zer dus/ nga'i sdod khang yang 'dom gang gru bzhi ma zhig las dgos kyi ma red gsungs pa grags pa sogs sngon mtha' dang phyi mtha' gzigs pa'i lung bstan mang du gnang 'dug go/ /mthu chen dkor srung gnyen po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar bstan pa srung ba zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams 'go zhing 'phrin las dang sdong grogs mdzad pa la/ ri khrod du bzhugs dus su gtor sgam las rgyun du sir sgra dang bcas me stag 'phro zhing / skabs 'gar sgam nang nas tsha sgra dang tshag sgra mang po grags te sa g.yo ba'i sgra lta bu byung tshe/ ha ha ci yin grag go zhes gsungs pa slob ma tshos rgyugs 'bul zhu dus sogs su yang yang thos zhes kam lha bu g.yang gis gsungs/ dam pa mchog dang dpal ldan bzang po sogs grwa sar phebs nas phyir byon skabs/ bod pa rtse drung zhig dang zhabrugs zing byung ste de nyid brdung brdeg drag po bgyis nas smag rum 'thibs pa'i nang bros byol du phebs/ mtshams shig tu dkor bdag drung pa rgyal po byon pa'i snga ltas su rwa gzhob 'thul zhing / de nas bung ba me stag 'phro bzhin byung ste lding skor rgyag pa dang / de nas ma bros zhu ba'i rtags la sngon ma'i mdung rtse las me 'bar zhing de la bh+ra ma ra babs pa dang bros mtshams bzhag ste gzims/ phyir nang bltas dus cung bros na gad pa chen po zhig dang thug 'dug ces kam g.yang las thos/ dgon gyi dge 'dun pa so so'i ca lag thengs mang dang grwa mang gi dngul phon chen bcas bor stor byung skabs/ bla ma mchog nas tshogs gral du bka' bslab lan mang gnang nas tshur sprod thabs mdzad kyang ma nyan pa na/ gzhan gyis re zhus bzhin las ngan de'i sdig 'phro gcod cing lus ngan gyi rten dang bral nas bde ba thob pa'i phyir du bskang gso 'tshogs te/chos srung la 'phrin bskul zhus nas mnyam bzhag thun gcig mdzad pa'i mthar shar 'bul phyogs nas 32

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/sdir sgra chen po zhig grags song zhing / tshogs pa grol ba na rkun ma nang rkun los yin te red 'dug la/red rgyu gcig las yod ma song a kha kha gsungs/ mi ring bar kho kho zer ba'i grwa log de nyid dus las yol te 'jig rten phyi ma'i lnga lam du gyur pa bla rgan rnams nas bshad/ gzig nang zog grangs de las mtho med pa'i ru ba bu spun gnyis nas ma rgan shi ba'i spur la kha'i lhas ra nas res gza' nyi ma'i nyin zhig tu mer bsregs pa dang / me mda' zhig gi rin tu zog sum cu ri khyu bcad de sprad pa/ spyang tshang nas spyang phrug cig bzung ste lhas mthar bskor ba sogs rten 'brel khyad bsad kyi bya ba mang du byas rjes bla ma'i khal tshe thar zhig brkus te zos shing / rje 'dis de la las 'bras kyi che ba 'don pa'i phyir du gtor bsngo skabs chos skyong la dam tshig dran bskul mdzad pas/ nub mo nye gnas pas gtor 'bul mchod skabs shig tu bla ma'i sgrub khang gi thad nas mgal me dmar 'bar ba zhig chad de gzig phu ru ba tshang gi phyogs su song ba mthong ste de ltar zhus pas 'o bsod zad de zhes gsungs/ mi ring bar a dang/la pho ba gas pa dang spyang 'phel gnyan 'dong rgyab ko ko nang nas 'gril ba bcas kyis skrun gnyis ka'ang mi rtag lnga pa'i lam du gyur cing / gnag phyugs nyis brgya lhag yod pa thams cad kyang lo gcig ma 'gor bar hon nad kyis shi ba ste/ zhal snga nas kyang / nga la gshin chog byas pa'i yon 'bul khal zhig yod pa tshe thar byas nas ri la yan du bcugs pa gzhan gyis zos song zhing / de la ngas las ngan kho la dang po snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgoms nas kho sha tsha snyam/ skabs shig na kho gzig sgang dmar mgo rab brtan dgon pa'i mkhan po byed/ mthu nus pa chen po can red zer na/ nga la rmi lam ngan tsam yang ma byung bsam na shes kyi ma red snyam nas nub 'gar gtor bsngo'i skabs dran tsam re byed rgyu red song bas/ rkun ma ni gnyan 'dong nang du rtswa btu song ba'i mi zhig 'gril nas shi ba de red 'dug cing /ngas de 'dra zhig byed dgos gtan nas ma bsam yang / las sdug po zhig red song zhes dbon stod byon dus mkhyen rab rje la zhus pa dgon gsar ngag mkhyen gyis gsan 'dug cing / rgyun par dgon du tshogs bsngo gnang ba gsungs rgyu 'dug la/srung mas 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i tshul 'og nas kyang 'byung 33

dge legs 'dod 'aro'i dpe tshogs/ngo / /des na 'di dag ni bdag 'dzin dang de las byung ba'i chags sdang gi 'byul rtog bcas thul zhing sdom pa dang dam tshig la nyes lhung gis ma gos pa sogs kyi lag rjes te/ rwa los dge bshes kun bsod la mgur bzhes pa las/ dmag 'brugs dang dug spyor ma byas kyang / /phyi dgra bo tshegs med thul ba 'di/ /nga ngan sngags mkhas pa ma lags te/ /nang gzung 'dzin dgra bo thul ba'i rtags/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub kame chags med kyis ri chos las/ dam tshig gtsang zhing bsnyen sgrub them pa dang / /gtor bsngos dgu gtor bskang gso brtson byas na/ /ched du las sbyor dmigs ngan ma byas kyang / /dgra la rtags dang cho 'phrul mang du 'byung / /ma bskul par yang gnod pa'i dgra bsgral zhes/ /dam tshig gtsang zhing lha srung 'khor rtags yin/ /de 'dra byung yang rang la sgrib pa med/ /'di yang myong bas lan mang grub pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu dam tshig can rnams lus dang grib ma ltar mnyam du 'grogs shing grogs mdzad pa la/ zhal snga nas/ nga sga khog tu legs pa rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar song ba'i thengs rjes ma'i tshe/ 'o thub bstan 'phel rgyas byon yod kyi red gsungs par/ bla ma rin po che yod lags zhus/ khyod kyi mtshams khang dang gnyan 'dong gnyis thag nye ba zhig yin rgyu red gsungs par/ yin lags nga'i mtshams khang gi mdun ri yin lags zhus/ 'o yin rgyu red/ da ci 'di na 'bri gnyan 'dong chen po phebs byung bas ci yin na bsam kyang / khyed byon 'ong ltas su yin 'dug gsungs par/ 'o na bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa'i gser skyems nang gi yul bdag skabs/ sa brgyad sems dpa' rdo rje blo gros dang / /zhes kha bsgyur na chog gam zhus pas/ 'o 'grig gi red ces dang / ngas sngar sna mdo tshong pa zhig las shel mig cig nyos te phul ba legs po byung yod tshod 'dug ste/ mtheb bong sgreng mdzad nas thub bstan g.yang bstan yin/ khyod kyis nga la byin pa'i shel mig de mchog tu gyur pa zhig yin do red/ sngar ngas lung 'don dus dum pa re las mi tshar yang / de gyon nas 'don dus dum pa phyed gnyis re tshar do red ces bcas gsungs myong zhes gsungs pa sngags rgan pad+ma rnam rgyal nas gsan cing/ lo na chung 34

grub dbang thub bsnyan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/dus klu'i gnod pas zhakhas la bsnyung gzhi drag pos thebs par/ chu mig cig gi shul yod pa'i gzig sgang na ba nang byon nas klu bsang dang klu gtor mang du mdzad/ de'i rkyen gyis sbrul dkar po zhig byung ste ke rer lang nas phyag 'tshal ba'i rnam pa ston pa thengs 'ga' dang / klu bum zhig gter du sbas pas de ma thag chu sngo nyil gyis byung la/ de nas 'dzad med chu'i gter gyis gzig sgang sde pa chu len thag ring 'gro dgos pa'i ngal ba bsal ba 'di tsam gyi bka' drin yang brjed thabs bral/ bka' las kyang /ngas de dus klu la gsol mchod bgyis te klu bum zhig sbas shul nas chu mig brdol ba'i rgyun da lta'ang yod red la/ klu dang grogs por gyur te de phyin chad char 'bebs gang du song yang char lon e 'ong snyam pa'i dwogs pa rtsa ba nas med ces rgan tshe stobs la gsungs so/ /des na da ltar dgon pas gser skyems bdud rtsi'i chu gter du sa brgyad sems dpa' rdo rje blo gros dang / /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma nam mkha'i mtshan/ /zhes kha bsgyur mdzad pa dang / dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i lha brgyad gser skyems nang du lha gnyer chen po rdo rje blo gros la/ /zhes dang /dkor srung gnyan po nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la/ /zhes zhal skong mdzad pa'ang rje nyid kyi phyag bzhes kyi rgyun 'chug med yin pas yid ches kyi gnas su bzung 'tshal lo/ /snang srid dag mnyam brdal ba'i 'bras rtags su/ /ya mtshan grub pa'i mtshan ma sna tshogs kyis/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i blo yi 'dzin ma la/ /zlog med dad pa'i pad+mo ci yang bzhad/ /mngon spyod drag po'i las la zhugs pa'i tshe/ /me yi phung po rang 'bar byung ba yis/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i myur lam la brten nas/ /'byung ba lnga la rang dbang sgyur ba mtshon/ / 35

dge legs 'dod 'khro'i dpe tshogs/rdo rje khros pa'i brtul zhugs la gnas te/ / nyams pa bdun du gtogs pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /zab yang mtha' bral lta ba'i 'brub khung du/ /bcugs te rnam thar sgo gsum rgya yis btab/ /rdo rje gzegs ma'i me char spros na yang / /rdo rje'i lus la tshugs pa med pa ni/ /rdo rje khro bo ma lha'i zhal can gyi/ /rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med gyur pa'i rtags/ / yan lag bzhi yi g.yul ngo ma bshams kyang / /rim gnyis brtan pa thob pa'i mthu kho nas/ /mi bsun skye bo 'bum gyis mi brdzi ba/ /dus 'dir khyod gcig rwa chen rdo rje grags/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang gsum yon tan kun/ /gcig bsdus gtum drag khro bo'i skur ston pa/ /he ru ka dpal gur gyi mgon po yis/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i shis pa stsol/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ dbus su phebs pa'i nyer bsdogs ji ltar mdzad pa dang / dngos su phebs nas rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skyabs rje grub dbang 'di yis yongs 'dzin bshes gnyen du ma las gdams zab rdzogs par bzhes te/ sngon nas sgrub pa nyams len mdzad par dbus phyogs su phebs grabs mdzad kyang / rab brtan sde dgon gnyis nas re brgya 36

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/mtheb slong gis zhu ba nan cher phul nas bshol btab pa'i rgyus/ gdul bya'i bsod nams kyi zhing du re zhig bzhugs pa yin la/ de ltar na'ang bla ma rang nyid bod du byon rgyur thugs 'dun che ba gzhir bzhag rdo rje mkhyen spyan mnga' ba'i dam pa gong ma'i dgongs brtags dang / lkog gyur mngon lung ston pa'i pra pa rnams la pra phab bcas zhus pa dag legs tshul byung ba ltar byon pa yin pas thog mar byon grabs mdzad pa de'i tshul cung zad brjod na/ 'dren mchog dam pa nyid nas phyag bris mdzad pa'i sde dge'i spyi khyab khang la phul ba'i dgongs zhus kyi yi ge ni/ zla bral las dbang gser gyi 'khor los nor 'dzin yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i 7gzhung sa chen po'i chab srid kyi 'phrin las pa chen po mi rje rin po che'i khri drung du/ gus pa rab brtan dgon gyi mkhan zur thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyis gnas tshul cung zad zhu ba/ phran gyi pha rgan byams pa dang ma bkra 'tsho zer ba gnyis la bu brgyud gus ming sring bzhi byung bar/ phran ni chung nas ban de byas/ rang lo bco lnga'i dus pha rgan dus kyi chos nyid du thim na'ang rang bsam rang gis btang nas mkhas grub kyi bla ma tshad ldan mang po gtsug tu bsten/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos la thos bsam phyogs tsam byas/ las rung gi bsnyen sgrub kyang cung zad bsdad zin nas 7lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi spyi rje 'ardzam mgon mkhyen brtse sprul sku'i bka' lung gyen bzlog ma spobs par dgon pa'i mkhan po'i las khur bgrang bya bcu'i ring dbyar gnas dang slob grwa la bka' bstan bcos rang gis blo yis dpog tshod bshad nas gdan tshab gzhan brkos dgongs khrol thob ste/ sgrub khang du sa yos nas 'di bar na shi gal chen skabs ma gtogs bsnyen sgrub lo bcu red song / sngon gyi las dbang gis sring mo gsum po rim gyis mi rtag lnga pa'i lam du gyur nas lhag rgyu ma rgan lo brgyad cu gya bdun can zhig dang / sring mo bla bde che ba'i dwa phrug pho mo gsum/ 'bring ba'i pho mo gnyis/ chung ba'i bu mo zhig dang drug tham pa lus byung bar/ don la skya lam ser lam tha dad na'ang lhag rgyur tshe las 'das ma de gsum dang rang gi lus bskyed byed kyi ma rgan lo na che rgyu/ long ba thang dkyil lus pa lta bu'i dwa phrug rnams skyabs med mgon med yin rgyu/ gang nas bsam yang pha ma 37

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/dga' na drin lan gyi dpe ltar red 'gro ba'i 'dun pas rnod rngas dkor rta dkor zog gis khral zha chag chad bul med pa de sngar sprad yod lags/ slar char de mus rgyun 'byams na 'di phyi gang thad dge med sdig can du 'gyur nges lags pas ma rgan bgrang bya gya bdun can 'di pa tshe 'phos ma thag tu gus dwa phrug thams cad kyis rang gi dkor sbyong pha ma gnyis kyi drin lan mjal ba'i ched dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du 'gro nas/ khyad par ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas la bskor ba tshad ldan zhig rkyeb chags kyis/ de bar gnas skabs rdo ltem ma 'jal gnyis kyi sa zhing tshang ma sngon rgyun ltar pha zhing bus me+o ngag dbang 'od zer tshang nas bya dus gus tshang gi zhing khang rtsa tshags dang khral rgyug mi bkra shis n+de brtan tshang khral tshab btsugs yod pas/ des na gus tshang phyir ma 'khor bar ma 'jal gnyis ka gzhan 'char med pa dang / sa zhing mgo'i khral las de sngar ltar yar mtho 'ded chog med pa dang/ khyad par ma rgan 'chi skug dang 'gro ba'i lta gon sogs kyis re zhig 'gor na'ang / de'i tshe da yan gzhan 'grigs ltar khral 'u lag sa zhing gzhan sprod pa sogs nyam chung brnyas bcos mi chog pa'i skyabs 'jug dang / kha zhe med par dngos su 'gro tshe'ang yul dgon ser skya sus kyang 'gal rkyen bar chad chos gegs gnas shul bkag 'gog gtan nas mi chog pa'i bka' zab btsan po gser gyi cod pan rin po che spyi bo'i rgyan du thob thub pa gsol ba snying nas 'debs pa lags so/ /zhes par/ lan du/ gsham gsal bde sdug zhu tho 'byor gsal rab brtan khral khongs dman bkra 'tsho dbus bsdus gnas mjal du song ring khral tshab bkra shis tshe brtan la mngags cha bgyis lugs zhu don rang 'khri khral 'bab la zhan chag med pa dgos rgyu dang / gong gsal dman bkra 'tsho bu phrug phyir 'khor mtshams rang gzhis rang bdag gis khral rgyug sngar bzhin byed pa las/ mi bdag bdag re'i dpe bzhin bka' skor su thad nas mi chog pa 'di thog mos 'thus yid 'doms byed/ sde dge spyi khyab khang nas/ sa byi zla 11tshes 30la/ zhes so/ /rgyal dbang karma pa la dgongs brtag zhus pa'i yi ge ni/ phyogs dus rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi gzugs/ khams gsum 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon/38

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/khams gsum srid zhi'i khongs su skyabs mchog mtshungs zla bral ba/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po mtshan don dang ldan pa 7kun mkhyen kame pa chen po'i zhabs pad gser khri mdzes pa gdong lnga'i dbang pos btegs pa'i nye ba'i drung du/ sor bcu'i thal mo gtsug tu zlum ste zhu gsol 'debs don/ 'dir mtshungs med 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku phreng bskal pa'i bar du byon dang 'byon 'gyur yongs kyi srung ma kun gyi rgyal po mgon po ber nag can gyi sku gzugs rdo ba nag po las grub pa 'di nyid phul bas/'di nas byang chub bar du 'bral med skyabs 'og chud pa'i dmigs med thugs rjes gathigs skyong dang /gus phran yar lha ldan phyogs song na 'di phyi'i don 'grub che min/ 'di phyogs bsdad na legs min gyi dgongs brtag gsal po gnang thub dang / ma zad gzhan bla ma rnams kyis mo rtsis gang thad nas byad ngo zhig 'dug gsungs pas/ de'i rbod gtong gang yin dang / de bzlog pa la rim gro gang gis phan pa'i bka' lung gser gyi cod pan spyi bo'i rgyan du thob thub pa'i bka' drin brtse gzigs chen po snying nas yang yang zhu zhu/ zhes zhu rten dar rgya gor 2tshe mdo brgya tshar bcas zhabs rim zhu/ zhes 'bri rgyud rab brtan nas gus pa mkhan zur thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyis sa stag zla 8pa'i tshes 17la phul ba'i zhu yig dge/ zhes par lan du/ bslab grol yon tan dpal mnga' dad dam dge ba mkhan thub bstan 'phel rgyas gang der/ ched don/ gsham gsal brtags 'bras/ lha ldan bskyod rgyu re zhig mi legs par rang gnas 'dug na bzang / byad phur bzlog rim gdugs dkar bzlog pa tshad ldan dang /gdugs dkar stong tshar/ sgrol chog gang mang gal che/ 'di nas rnam kun legs tshogs gong 'phel dang legs lam gang che'i skyabs srung zab spel bgyid/ mdud dam bcas dpal spungs nas dpal kame pa'i mtshan 'dzin nas dge/ zhes 'dug go/ skyabs gcig mkhyen brtse sprul sku'i mdun phul ba'i brtags zhus kyi zhu yig gnyis ni/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag skye ba gtan gyi skyabs gcig 'jam mgon mchog sprul rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs pad lha brgya'i gtsug nor mchog drung du/dwangs pa'i yid mtshor mngon par skyes pa'i sor bcu'i thal mo gtsug tu zlum ste gsol ba 'debs 39

dge legs 'dod 'arnga'i dpe tshogs/don/ deng phyogs dus rnam 'dren yongs kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od rdul gcig tu bzlums pa'i gsang gsum nam mkha'i nor bu bod ldongs bsod nams kyi dpung na gsal zhing bstan 'gro phan bde'i pad tshal ci dgar grol ba'i mdzad bzang 'od snang phyogs mthar brdal bzhugs bka' drin dang dad spro rab dga'i dpal ltar spro/ 'dir gnas skyabs 'og pa'ang gang gi thugs rjes rten lus bde ba'i tshul du 7rje nyid kyi bka' bzhin gzig sgang rang gnas khang bu'i nang bsdad nas tshe sbyin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bsnyen sngags bgrang ba'i tshul du 'khum/ da ltar rang gi lus bskyed pa'i ma rgan bgrang bya gya brgyad can 'di pa tshe 'phos ma thag tu gus pa'i sring mo bla bde gsum gyi dwa phrug pho mo drug khrid nas/ yar lha ldan 'gro nas ra sa zhabrul snang gi gtsug lag khang la bskor ba 'bum ther re rgyeb chags kyi 'dun pa lags so/ /de'ang de lo gter mdzod rdor sems sgrub chen skabs 7rin po che'i dngos zhal mjal tshe gnas skabs gzig sgang 'dug na lo du/ nam zhig 'di na mi dga' 'di na dga' du bsam pa zhig 'ong bas de dus de na 'gro dgos/ u tshugs kyis sdod mi nyan gsungs don ltar/gus pa'i khyim tshang pha mes tshun chad nas khral pa yin gshis/ ma rgan lo che rgyu/ dwa phrug 'go 'dzin gyis blta dgos rgyu/ khral che rgyu sogs gang thad nas 'chi kha chos mthun zhig mi 'ong nges can red pas khral tshab gzhan btsugs tshar/ gong zhus bzhin ma rgan 'chi tshar mtshams 'gro rgyu red tshe legs nyes ci 'gyur/ rtorgo gcig mtshams song na legs)/ nyes na bzlog sel rim gro gang dgos dang / ltasgol ma 'bum gcig 'don na lam 'gro 'byung ngo )/ /khyad par phran lcags byi lo pa da ltar bgrang bya lnga bcu red song ba da nas lo ji tsam 'dug pa'i tshe tshad nges can zhig gnang mdzad thub ci nas mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ lta'i tshad ci yang mi shes)/ skyabs rten 'brel mtshon dar dngul gor 8gos chen zab lpags phran bu bcas gus slob thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyis sgo gsum gus pas 'bul lam zhu/ phur pa 'di gnam lcags yin min ma shes pas ji yin bka' 'dri dang / ji ltar yin pa'i bka' gsungs kyang gnang stsol zhu/ zhes phul bar lan du/ brtags pa mchan gsal dang / skyabs 'jug g.yel 40

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/med bgyid/ mdud dam bcas mkhyen sprul pas/ zhes dang / tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs gcig rigs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid khyab bdag mchog sprul 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs kyi pakhro'i drung du/ sgo gsum gus pa chen pos zhu ba/ deng rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang zhal mngon du phye ba'i dge mtshan gyis bstan 'gro yongs kyi skyabs rten du bzhugs par dad dang spro ba'i pad tshal rab tu rgyas/ 'di ru gsungs las skyes pa'i bka' 'bangs tha chung ba'ang skyabs gcig mtshungs pa med pa'i thugs rjes zag bcas nyer len gyi phung por gsar 'tshe'i nongs pas ma gos par lhag bsam bzang po'i kun slong ma bor tsam du mchis lags/ mtshams zhu/ nyid kyi dgongs khyab dang dus kyi zing cha'i stabs snga mkho bzhin gzig sgang du bsdad yod kyang / da cha'ang ci 'gyur ma nges pas bod du 'gro rgyu dang khams su sdod rgyu gang dga' gsung brtag dang / (spyogs mtshungs la cung bod du legs che zhing de lugs thugs khyab/) khams su sdod rgyu legs na sngar gnas gzig sgang dang /gzhan du spos na gang legs gsung brtag dang bslab ston bcas zhu/ dur ba/ yung dkar/ dar log yan gsum bcas/ gus phran thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyis sgo gsum gus pas 'bul lam zhu/ zhes springs par/ lan du brtags pa mchan gsal dang / gal srid bod du 'gro rgyu red na lha sa rang du rgyun ring bzhugs na legs ngo med cing / dbus gtsang gang rigs dben gnas shig tu snying po'i sgrub pa la rtse gcig gzhol rgyu dgongs khyab dang / nged nas skyabs 'jug bgyid/ dar/ mdud dam/ rin chen rdog gcig bcas mkhyen sprul pas/ zhes gsungs so/ /dgon pas bskyar du mkhyen sprul par phul ba'i zhu shog ni/ bstan pa yongs kyi bdag po skyabs gcig rdo rje 'chang 7'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po mchog gi zhabs pad nye drung du/ gus 'bangs rnams kyis sor bcu'i thal mo snying khar zlum ste zhu snying la/ 'dir dgon gyi mkhan bla ma thub bstan 'phel rgyas sos thog bod la gnas bskor byon rgyu gtan khel mdzad kyang/ dgon gyi bla ma las tshan gtsos 'dus spyi yongs rdzogs dang / ma tshad pho mo rgan bu bcas skya ser kun nas mig chu 'dzag ngang kha zhe gnyis med kyis mi byon rogs zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal 41

dge legasa'adod 'asna'i dpe tshogs/nas/ ngos nas skyabs rje nyid mdun sngon rjes bar gsum du bod du 'gro rgyur brtags pa zhus nas/zhus don ltar yag 'dug pas 'di lor 'gro rgyu gra sgrig thag chod yin pa'i gsungs tshul gnang byung bas/ gal srid nyid byon na gshin gson kun gyi re sa bor nas dwa phrug thang dkyil du lus pa bas yid mug che ba yang yang zhus thog da dung yang bskyar skyabs rje nyid mdun bod du byon bzhugs gnyis 'phral yun gang legs bka' brtags dang / ma zad byon bzhugs gang mdzad na'ang zhabs rim sogs gang dgos kyi bka' bslab stsol ba gsol ba lan stong 'debs pa zhu zhu zhu/ mkhyen/ mkhyen/zhes zhu mtshon bkra shis pa'i lha reg dang / dngul rgya srang lnga bcas rab brtan dgon grwa mang 'dus spyi nas gus pas phul/ zhes pa'i lan la/ gsham gsal bla ma sngar nas bod du byon mos yod rgyur/nged kyi mo babs skyon med legs la de ltar yin kyang khyed rnams dad mos che bas khag med lta bu dang /bla ma'i zhabs brtan tshe thar 300rgyal bka' dag tshar 1 sman chog stong rtsa/ smyung gnas cha 300'phral du sgrub 'bul zhu ste bzhugs rgyu mdzad na legs pas dgongs 'jags/ zhu 'degs dang rten phyir 'bul bcas mkhyen sprul pas/ zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar bla ma mchog gis phyag bris mdzad cing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha mchog dang ldan pa'i zhu yig 'di rnams dad pa'i gsos su dmigs te mthar chags su bkod pa yin no/ /zhu shog 'di rnams gna' lugs ltar shog bu kha gang re la gong shog dang phab lcag snga phyi mtha' shog lan bcas thob dang mthun zhing / phyi ma bzhi la lan du karma pa dang chos blo gnyis kyi phyag bris rgyas mnan pa 'dug pra phab zhus pa'ang khra rgan gcod pa la pra
