phab tu bcugs nas thengs bzhir phab pa na/ dang po la ka ba chen po zhig dang / gnyis pa la zhing 'dra mang po bcas babs shing / de ni rje nyid 'bri chu shar nub yongs dang khyad par 'di pa'i sde dgon zung gi khang pa'i dkyil ka ltar re sa rten gnas gcig pur gyur nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub pa dang / bar du dus kyi 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ste zhing pa dbul phyug gi gral rim bsgrig tshe bla ma nyid zhing 'bring zhig gi gras su 'jog pa ste de gnyis kyi brda yin la/ phyi ma gnyis la gnag phyugs mang po yod pa'i 'brog 42

grub dbang thub bsnyan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/pa'i sbra chen zhig dang / gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku bkrag mdangs can zhig mthar 'od phung gi gong bur gyur pa bcas shar ba ste/ de ni sku tshe'i smad la lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs sbra nag zhol smon 'grub byang du bzhugs nas skye bo mang po'i rgyud grol bar mdzad pa dang / mthar zag bcas 'byung lnga'i khams lnga dag pa ye shes 'od lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i mtshan ma yin par gsungs/ yang de skabs tsam na pra phab zhu yul gang yin ma nges kyang pra thengs gnyis phab pa'i gcig gi tshe/ spyir las tshogs las 'byams dang khyad par drag po mngon spyod kyi las la dbang 'byor pa'i rtags su rdo nag zur gsum gyi steng du rdor dril cha gcig babs pa kho bo'i mes po thub bstan mkhas grub kyis gsungs shing / byon bzhugs gang legs brtags pas byon na me phung rab tu 'bar ba zhig dang / bzhugs na chu klung chen po 'jigs su rung ba zhig babs pa thos/ de la me ni dbus phyogs su phebs na 'gro don mthar ru phyin te gzhan ngor gdung zhugs la phul rgyu byung ba'i brdar go la/ phyi ma'i brda dkrol ni re zhig smra bsam brjod med kyi dbyings su brda thim/ rab rgyal shing lug lor 'jam mgon mkhyen sprul pa chen po dbus phebs skabs bla ma nyid gnam brag tu bsu bar phebs shing / skor zur thang du zhag bzhugs mdzad tshe gser phye thum po zhig dang / rta mdzo gnyis/ dngul sogs kyi 'bul ba dpang mtho ba phul nas bod du phebs rgyu'i thad la bka' 'dri zhus pas/ rjes mi ring ba'i mtshams su bod du byon mos shin tu che ba'i dus shig 'ong 'dra bas de dus byon na legs la/ nga'i mdzod pa tshe dbang dpal 'byor bod du 'gro rgyur mo phywa ma legs kyang 'gro dgos byung song bas/ nged cag sku 'khor rnams gshin rje'i sgo nas thugs zhabs ma 'bor zhes sogs gsungs shing / dngul rdo tshad gcig gnang ste thugs brtse chen pos khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas skyabs mchog dam pa gang gi 'gyur med kyi dam bca' brtan pos gzhi byas/ lo dang zla ba re bzhin dus zing gi 'ur je cher song ste las 'bras khyad du gsod pa sogs kyis thugs sun pas rkyen byas nas bla mas lung bstan pa'i dus thog tu khel ba ltar byung ste/ sa khyi 1958lor dus zhakhrugs skabs da ni nges par du stod phyogs su 'gro rgyu yin pas/43

dge legs 'dod 'arnga'i dpe tshogs/khyed cag sus kyang bgol mi nyan gsungs nas rang dgon gyi mgon khang du byon te/ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa la snyan dar spyan gzigs tshogs gtor skyems phud sogs rgya cher phul nas/ nan tan gyis bskang bshags 'phrin bcol bcas rgyas par mdzad/ de'i rkyen gyis bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i ngo bor dbyer med du bzhugs pa'i 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor chen po mchog nyid dbus phyogs su phebs pa la/ srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyis gus 'dud dang bcas mjal phyag gi rten du phul nas ci bcol 'phrin las sgrub pa'i brda la/ kun gzigs 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos me stag 'phro ba ma byung gi bar du sgrub pa mdzad de ye shes pa dngos su bstims pa'i gzungs 'grub mgon po'i snyan dar gyi khrod nas/ rab dkar dri mas dben pa'i kha btags nyams med cig mi'i lag gis 'phang pa ltar byas te bla ma'i mgul du bsgron pa zhig byung bas/ zhabs drung na bzhugs pa'i tshogs pa kun shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su gyur to/ /des na 'di ni kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges zhing skyong gdong bzhi par bskang gso mdzad pas dngos grub kyi rten du mda' dar zhig gnang ba dang / mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis sgo rum gser mgon chen po la phyag mdzad pas bkras thag bzang ba zhig rgyang gis byung zhing / yang nang so pu tra khang du thugs dam du phebs pas/ las mgon gyi sku las gos chen sngon po kha ma nyams pa zhig babs pa bcas dang mtshungs par snang la/ 'di 'dra rten 'brel gyi dge mtshan khyad du 'phags shing ches dkon pa'i rnam thar yin pa'ang / sa lo kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rnam tharacilas/ sku las snyan dar babs pa 'di 'dra re re tsam ma gtogs mi 'byung bas rten 'brel bzang / zhes dang / 'di lta bu ni rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs zhi khro rab 'byams rnams dang dbyer med du bzhugs pa la/ bstanasrung dbang po rnams kyi gtso bo nyid kyis kyang gus 'dud mdzad pa gdon mi za bar snang bas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshogs gnyis rlabs phreng g.yo ba'i chu gter las/ /44

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/thon pa'i gang sku bcu gnyis bdag po'i zer/ /re zhig rang yul bsod nams zhing bzhugs te/ / blang dor gsung gi dbugs dbyung ci yang bstsal/ /dbus su bzhud na legs pa'i lung bstan gyi/ /dbyar gyi rnga gsang skyes chen du ma yis/ /sgrib bral thugs kyi mkha' nas ldir ba'i mod/ /gang thugs me bya dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs ngom/ /byin ldan rten la bskang 'phrin mdzad pa'i mod/ /sna tshogs dar gyi mchod sprin spro ba 'dis/ /bgrang yas rgyal ba sras slob bcas pa yis rīgang la dgyes pa'i legs so ster ba mtshon/zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /gang gi mtshan tsam rna bar lhung bas kyang / /dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs las dbugs 'byin pa'i/ /rgyal yum 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yis/ /mi 'chi tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar 'dren mchog bla ma rin po che dbus su phebs pa'i sta gon legs 'grigs byung ste/ de nas sa khyi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga la dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing du chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur te lha sgang tshang sogs dang lhan du byon cing / mdo gzhung rtis mda' thang la zhag bzhugs mdzad nub mdzo zhig rkun mas khrid song bar/ bla mas chos skyong la 'phrin bcol mdzad pas phyi nyin mdzo sha cha tshang ba rang mal du bzhag 'dug pa byung / de nas gter ston nas rim gyis byon te lha thog gsang chen nang 45

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/zhes par zla ba gsum la bzhugs/ sngon nas gzhi spo byas pa'i mdun sa dkar tshang nyi smris nang yod pa'i bran mo ltag mdo nas rdzi'u song ba dred mong gis bsad cing / de ni g.yog po dag gis ri mgo nas gzhi bdag gi shwa ba bsad pas phog thug byung ba yin zer/ de'i rkyen gyis gshin po de dngos rgyug byed pa'i shi 'dre ngan pa zhig tu gyur te gtam smra zhing khyim las byed pa sogs mi 'dod pa mang po byung / de la ldongs gnas sogs kyi nus ldan sngags gcod du mas bzlog rim gang zab bsgrubs kyang phan bskyed cher ma byung nas lus sems sdug gis khengs te sdod re bral song zhes smra dgos byung / bla ma lha thog nang byon pa dang ra ru tshang gis zhu sna brgyud de rna phu sa dkar tshang nas gdan drangs shing / dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khro bo bcu gcig gi sreg blug nub gcig la mdzad tsam gyis rkyen ngan rang sa las grol ba byung ste/ phyogs der nus pa che ba'i g.yer khas khyab/ de nas yang byon pas sog gzhung du 'byor te zhag bzhugs mdzad cing / de'i tshe rkun mas khal gnyis la stan dkar nyer gcig bkal nas brkus song bar/ bla mas dgra chos tshar lnga gsungs nas zor chu mtsho nang 'phangs pas/ phyi nyin chom rkun pas khal gnyis stan dang bcas pa phyir phul nas bshad rgyur/ kho tshos khal ded nas 'gro dus khal gyi rwa rtse nas me 'bar ba dang / spu gseb nas me stag 'phro ba sogs mi legs pa'i rtags sna tshogs byung bas skrag ste phyir phul tshul bshad cing bshags pa rgya cher byas/ de nas chibs las btegs te rwa sgreng du thon cing / zhag bdun la bzhugs nas mchod mjal gnang / de nas rim pas gser gling rgod tshang dang stag lung thang gi chos grwa mjal zhing / chag la brgal nas chu shul snye thang du thegs/ sgrol ma gsung byon ma sogs kyi rten la mchod sprin rgya cher spros te sgrol chog gsungs nas zhag brgyad la bzhugs/ kun mkhyen rong ston chen po'i gdan sa nā len+d+ra ru byon nas mchod 'bul rgya cher stabs shing / de nas snye thang nas lha sar byon/ pho brang chen po po ta la dang se 'bras dga' gsum sogs dbus kyi dgon sde mang por mjal mdzad cing / sa phag lo'i lo gsar skabs lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshogs la zhugs te gser kong phul/ slar yang sa ga zla ba'i nang 'phan yul du byon 46

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/nas sku mtshams bzhugs shing / de skabs zing zhakhrugs byung ba'i rkyen gyis bzhugs bde bar ma byung nas bsam yas dang lto kha sogs su gnas mjal du phebs/ de nas bod zla drug pa sngon ma'i nang zhig tu dwags po nas bla ma rin po che dpon g.yog dmag gis khrid de sne gdong rdzong du nyar zhing / de'i tshul bka' las kyang / de nyin nyi tshan zhig tu dmag mis khrid nas dang por gnam btags byas byung zhing / zug gzer mi 'dug kyang gzhan rnams kyis a ra a na mang po zer 'dug pas dgos rgyu red snyam ste a ra a na kha shas lab pa yin/ mtshams shig nas dmag dpon gzugs ring po can zhig byung ste/ des yang yang lta nas ltod bkrol btang byung zhing / rang nas bdag ni dgon pa'i mkhan po dang / mi ser la bshu gzhog byed pa/ rgyu za ba po yin sogs smras pas zhing 'bring zhig gi gras su brtsis te/ de nas btson pa'i ming thogs tsam las sdug bsngal ba ma byung ngo zhes a don dang bstan 'dzin nor bu sogs la gsungs/ de nas lha ldan nor bu gling gi nye 'dabs kyi khrims khang zhig tu gdan drangs te bzhugs la/ de'i tshe tsam du gtsug lag khang 'ga'i bdag gnyer pa bzhag ste nyin mtshan ltos med kyis srung skyong gnang / de nas dgung grangs drug cu re gsum bzhes pa chu stag 1962lor btson las thar nas ra mo che rdo zam khar bzhugs shing / skog tu dbon mo spen pa 'tsho khrid nas gling bskor bskor tshad 'gro bar mdzad/ de nas dgung grangs don drug steng phebs pa shing yos 1975lor sngon bsags las smon bzang pos mtshams sbyar ba'i sga pa tshe ring stobs ldan mchog gis srid gzhung la nga rang gi a zhad yin zhus te/ khong gi bzhugs gnas lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi nye 'dabs sbra nag zhol smon 'grub byang zhes pa'i sgo ra ru spyan drangs nas khong bla slob gnyis khang pa steng shod mdzad nas bzhugs shing / khong yum sras rnam pas bla ma sku 'khor dang bcas pa la lhag bsam zol med kyis rgyab skyor dang sri zhu bcas legs par zhus pa bka' drin che/ gzhan yang nges 'phrad dbul skyabs sogs mi chen khag du ma dang / mos gus lam du byed pa'i 'gis thog bu tsha sogs mang pos zhabs tog ci lcog phul 'dug la/ de rnams kyang tshe rabs sngon nas 'brel pa bzang po thob pa'i 47

dge legs 'dod 'arnga'i dpe tshogs/las ldan gyi skyes bu yin par ldog tu med do/ /de nas klu lding mkhan chen phebs dus thengs gcig ma gtogs pa sgo ra phyi la phebs myong med cing / zab mo'i lam la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag pa las g.yo ba med bzhin du bzhugs pas/ tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad stong chen gyi dbyings su dag ste nyin mtshan dang mnyam rjes res 'jog med pa'i nyams khor yug tu shar la/ de'i rkyen gyis zhal 'don zer ba'i dpe ldeb gcig dang phreng ba zhig kyang bgrang rgyu med cing / sku bcar zhu ba rnams la dgong mo la sa rub e red dang snga dro la phyi dro e red sogs gsungs pa mang ngo / /'di ni bla ma nā ro pas rnal 'byor pa byas te bsgoms pas rtogs pa skyes nas glu blangs pa las/ 'char ba med cing nub pa med/ /nyin mo med cing mtshan mo med/ /bla ma'i rtogs pas me+ongs pa chad nas song / /gar gnas gar 'gro ma shes te/ /zhes sogs dang / grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ spyod thog tu lta sgom khel rtsa na/ mnyam rjes med pa'i nyams rtogs 'char/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'jam mgon sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po klu lding 'jam dbyangs bstan pa'i nyi ma mchog rab rgyal chu khyi lor bod du phebs dus lha sar byon nas shar lho'i mgron khang nang du bzhugs shing / de'i tshe shar chen klu lding pa rje 'di'i mdun du snyan brgyud gsan par phebs rgyu'i dgongs pa 'dug pa gsan pa dang / khong ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal tshab dam pa'i skyes bu chen po yin pas tshur ga la phebs 'os/ de bas phar bcar te dbang zhig zhus na rten 'brel yag po yod red gsungs nas phar phebs mdzad/ rje de las dpul kye rdo rje'i dbang dang / kun rig gi dbang zhig zhus shing phar yang 'gal rkyen bar chad sel nas sku tshe yun du brtan pa'i ched du tshe sgrub kyi dbang dang bskyed rim bsgom tshul sogs gsungs nas chos 'brel legs par bzhag de skabs dang tshe stobs kyis khyim gdan zhus pa'i tshe gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang zhing / rje 'dis ngas kha ton dpe ldeb lag tu ma blangs nas mi lo bdun red song zhes zhus skad 'dug klu lding mkhan chen nas rgya gser stod 'gag shin tu spus ldan zhig sogs kyi gnang skyes gya nom par bstsal/ 'jam mgon chos kyi blo gros kyi yang srid 'jam dbyangs thub bstan chos kyi rgya 48

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/mtsho mchog bod dbus su byon dus bla ma'i mdun zhal mjal la phebs shing / phan tshun chos kyi 'brel bzhes shing bla mas 'di ni bdag gis 'jam dpal mtshan brjod 'bum phrag cig kha gang la nye bar bton pa'i thugs dam gyi rten yin gsungs nas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sku zhig phul bar mdzad/ tshar pa nā len+d+ra'i mkhan chen byams pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mchog la zhal shes man ngag gi skor mang por bstsal cing / smin gling gcung rin po che ngag dbang chos grags thengs 'gar phebs pa la'ang 'dod chos bstsal te rjes su bzung / 'jam rgyal mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' tshul khrims gnas bskor la byon nas lha sar la yod dus rje 'di mjal kha zhus pa na/ gang blo ma'i chos 'brel zhig gnang zhing / de skabs 'o nyag bla rin po ches gsungs mdzad du zer red/ ngas thugs los dag bsam byung / 'gro rgyu rkyang pas sangs shig rgyas na a co 'di rnams sangs rgyas 'gro dgos par rgyas rgyu mi 'dug 'don rgyu rkyang pas sangs shig rgyas na a mchod 'di rnams sangs rgyas 'gro dgos par rgyas rgyu mi 'dug ces gsungs byung bas/ sgrub pa bgyis na ma gtogs mchog gi dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i gdams ngag tu go ste/ gnas bskor sogs la spro ba cher med pa zhig tu gyur song zhes sprul sku nyid kyis gsungs pa thos/ gzhan yang rta rgyug mkhan po la rdo rje'i gsung gi bka' slob zab mo dang chos sbyin bcas gnang zhing / de dus zhabs zhu ba zung gis bskul ba ltar thub bstan rgyal mchan dpal bzang nas zhabs brtan gsol 'debs mdor bsdus shig kyang phul/ gnam brag mkhan brag bla kame bkra shis dang / gser ljang mkhan thub chos sogs la'ang chos sbyin mang du bstsal nas rgyud grol bar mdzad cing / brag bla la zhal 'phros kyi tshul du lha sa'i mi 'di tshos nges don gyi chos byed kyi mi 'dug ces dang / mchod mi shes pa yis mchod pa bas/ bza' shes pa zhig gis bzas na dga' zhes gsungs/ tshe stobs 'bras spungs su 'gro dgos byung dus shig tu bla ma mchog nas 'bras spungs lam rim rin po che la skyabs rten du shog sgor nyi shu dang dar bcas bskur/ lam rim rin po che ngag dbang phun tshogs la de ltar phul bas sde dge nas phebs pa'i mkhan rgan de e red 49

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/gsungs/ yin tshul zhus pas/ khong dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed sku dngos yin 'dug pas thugs rje'i skyabs 'og nas ma 'bor zhu rogs gsungs nas dar dang shog sgor bzhi bcu bskur gnang mdzad ces tshe stobs las thos pa dang / spo lu mkhan rin po che nas phyi ltar gnas brtan ngur smig 'dzin pa'i gtso/nang ltar 'gro la brtse ba'i khur chen bzhes/ /gsang ba dgyes mdzad lha dang mi gnyis pa'i/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs rgyu mtshan mkhyen pa'i dam pa mang pos lhag pa'i lha'i ngo bo nyid du mgrin dbyangs gcig gis bsngags pa'i me tog gtor/ sngon sde dge sa srung la 'ong dus bla ma mjal myong ba'i bod pa nyi ma zer ba gdon gyis brlams te bla mar bcar dus g.yas g.yon nas skyor 'gro dgos par/ bla mas bka' bsgo mdzad nas phyir log dus gzhan la ma brten par 'gro nus pa byung ba dang / bla ma dang sgo ra gcig tu gyur pa'i blo bzang snyan grags chung ngu'i dus kyi mtshan mo zhig tu kho nad tshab che ba zhig gis thebs te/ mig gis blta ba sogs mi nus pa zhig gyur dus/ khye'u bla ma'i mdun khyer bas bla mas phyag phreng mgo la bzhag nas bka' bsgo mdzad ma thag byis pas bla ma la lta nas dgod nus pa byung ba sogs gdon bgegs kyis gtses te skugs brgyal spyo ba ltar gyur pa rnams la byin rlabs dang bka' bsgo re mdzad tsam gyis nad sangs drag tu gyur pa'i tshul mang zhing / a za pad legs nas ding ri tshong la song na dang/ rang yul du logs pa/ lha sar sdod rgyu bcas gang legs phyag mo zhus pas/gsum ka la tshag re 'dug cing / de bas lha sa rang du bsdad de khyod rang nas sgrol bstod 'bum ther gcig lo gcig la 'gro bar gyis dang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'ong rgyu yod gsungs/ legs so zhus te sems kyis lo gcig nang tshar e 'ong na snyam pa na/ nyin mor stong re thon/ mtshan mor stong re thon dang mgyogs par tshar 'gro red/ gti mug gi dbang du btang nas yun ring gnyid du logs pa las lus 'tsho ba'i gnyid la chu tshod re las yod ma red gsungs pa sogs mos ldan gyi 'gro ba tsho'i blo'i re ba rnams tshul bzhin du bskang bar mdzad pas kun gyis blo 'dri yul dang / khyad par khams phyogs kyi mi che chung kun gyi brten sa lta bur gyur ces thos so/ /jo bo'i rigs lnga sogs brdung ba'i mgar ra ba 50

grub dbang thub bsnyan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/chen po go 'jo ngo ring pad+ma bla ma'i mdun bcar te/ khyed kyis phyag mo 'debs dgos zhu tshad la ma btab na dga' ba 'dug ces zhus/ bla ma mchog nas tshe stobs la pad+mas nga la mo ma rgyag zer bas ci byed gsungs par/ srid jus kyang cung dam skabs yin zhing bla ma nyid kyis sngon nas ngas mo btab pa la yag mo mi 'dug sbag brgyag na khe sa e 'dug mo btab dgos sogs zer 'ong 'dug ces gsungs nas mo la mi dgyes pa'i tshul ston stabs/ pad+mas de ltar gsungs dus mo ma btab na e dga' na zhus pas/ da nas mo mi 'debs gsungs nas shwa phor phyag tu bzhes te/ ngas mo re btab dus chos srung la bden bdar re bgyis nas shwa 'di sngags yod pas sku gzugs li ma zhig las dga' ba yod/ da ni khyod la sbyin gsungs nas shwa shwa phor dang bcas pa gnang bar mdzad/ nyin bdun brgyad gang rung song ba na ngas mo ma btab pas rmi lam du dred mong 'dra 'ong zhing / dmag zor mas phrag dog byed kyin 'dug gsungs la/ 'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo rang 'khor yin pa'i mtshan ma nges so/ /skabs shig na tshe stobs la rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gnas min gcig ngo mtshar rten bzhi'i nang tshan gyi rnam rgyal mchod rten la ltos pas/ de nyid nyams gso byed rgyu byung na ma 'chugs zhes lung bstan 'dra ba gsungs/ des na sa skya'i rnam rgyal sku 'bum du grags pa'i rten mchog 'di ni ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pas rang gi thugs dam gyi rten du bzhengs shing / rab gnas kyi me tog gtor tshe bum pa las mthong tshad kyi sa gzhi bar snang khyab pa'i 'od ser po gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu 'phros pa dang / legs so zhes pa'i sgra mi che bar lan bzhir byon pa/dril bu'i sgra 'dra bar grags pa sogs ltas bzang po du ma byung ba dang / de nas ring bsrel chad med du byon pa skal ldan rnams kyis rnyed 'dug cing / re 'gas ma rnyed tshe sku 'bum gyi sa dum re khyer ba byung la/ des rten la gnod kyis dwogs nas gong ma bsod nams rin chen sogs kyis nyams gso gang dgos dang / de nyid nang gzungs tshul du bzhugs pa la meng nas gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gdugs 'bor char khebs tog dang bcas pa'i bar gsar du bzhengs shing / phyis dus 'gyur chen mo'i tshe phyi'i 51

dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dpe tshogs/ gser zangs thams cad bshus te sku 'bum dngos lha khang gshegs 'og tu bzhugs pa zhig yin/ rjes mar gdan sa gong nas kyang khong la rten de zhig gso byed par zhu ba'i skul ma thengs 'gar byung la/de'i tshe bla mas lung bstan pa'i thog tu khel ba yin nam snyam nas/ bla ma'i gdung rus la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab ste nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang thub bstan 'phel rgyas mngon sum ltar byon nas phyag g.yon pa'i srib mdzub de bstan te/ 'di sangs rgyas kyi sku sha rlon pa red la/ 'di 'dra nang gzungs su byas pa'i rten de bzhengs na dge zhes gsungs pa rmis pas nyams gso byed mgo brtsam na bya ba mthar 'gro yong bar go byung gsungs/ de nas sku 'bum nang rten du bzhugs pa la se ra nas thob pa'i zangs gser gyi sgo ldeb rnams kyis phyi rten gyi rgyu byas nas snga lugs ltar lha khang dang bcas pa bde blag tu grub pa byung zhes thos/ yang bla ma mchog gis khong la ngor e waṃ chos sde 'di dar rgyas su byung na sa skya'i dgon sde khag gzhan rnams dar yong ba som nyi dang bral/ de bas ngor dgon 'di nyams gso byed rgyu byung na rang dgon nyams gso byed pa las lhag ces gsungs myong la/ de'i rkyen gyis srid gzhung la don 'khyol zhus te ngo mtshar che ba'i 'jam dpal bzhengs sku sogs sku gzugs bcu gnyis ngor dgon la phul bas mtshon zhabs 'degs mi chung ba bsgrubs la/ bla ma rang gi gdan sa rab brtan dgon du'ang snga rjes su rogs skyor dang / gnang skyes ja nom pa mdzad dang mdzad mus su mchis pa sogs bla ma mchog gi 'phrin las kyis bdag rkyen byas pa las khong nas bstan rgyun la phan thogs pa rgya che bar 'dug go/ klad med re zung gis sku gzugs dang mchod rten sogs pha nor rnying pa byin ldan rin thang che ba rnams tshong zog tu bsgyur nas kla klor bskyar nye skabs/ rang nor rang bdag bgyid pa la sems dpa' mi zhum pa'i tshong pa re 'gas nyo rgyu byas te/ bla ma mchog la rgyu bzang ngan dang rin thang byin rlabs che chung sogs kyi thad du bka' 'dri zhus pa'i tshe/ dngos po de dbu thog tu bzhes pa dang phyag tu nom pa 'ga' mdzad nas/ gang yin thugs thogs med par gsungs 'ong ba sku drung na gnas pa rnams dang tshong pa tshos zer 'dug cing / bla ma nyid nas bsam yas rdo ra nyams med khyad mtshar zhig 52

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/blus mdzad la/ sku dbon dkon tshe la'ang dzhai k+ṣim gyi bka' gdams mchod rten zhig sogs blu bcugs 'dug sku tsha tshe yi rig byed 'dzin pa a don me sbrul lor lha sar song dus bka' las/ nga la mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang gis sgrub btus shig 'don dgos pa'i bka' yod kyang dus kyis rkyen pas bya thabs bral/ da lan bla ma'i bka' la bsam nas sgrub btus sdi lung zhig bton bcugs dgos snyam pa yin/khyod kyis spar khang nang nas sgrub btus kyi dpe cha zhig lon thabs bgyis te skur shog gsungs shing phyi lor phul rgyu byung / phyis song tshe dpe cha de legs po red byung / lung bton bcugs pas sgrub btus pod bcu bzhi po blor zhog stong zhes pa'i bka' bstsal zhes zhang po a don nyid kyis bshad/ g.yung drung bzod pa sogs 'tsho byed pa mang pos shing kun cung nis shig bsdus kyang sman nus thon pa ma nus nas bla ma 'di la bka' 'dri zhus tshe/ sman rnams ngos 'dzin gang 'dra byas te bsdus yin gsungs/ de'i chul zhus pas/ 'o shu dag de ngos 'dzin nor ba red/ de'i ngos 'dzin gsal tsam sgrub thabs kun btus kyi 'jam dbyangs sgrub thabs nang yod red gsungs / phyis de bzhin bgyis pas sman nus thon pa byung ste the tshom gyi rgya las bsal ba tshe stobs sogs rgyus yod rnams kyis gleng la/ sgrub btus kha pod nang bzhugs pa'i 'jam dpal smra seng gi sgrub thabs ril bu'i sbyor ba las/ shu dag dkar po ni/dbyibs shu dag nag po 'dra ba/ dri de las chung ba/ mdog dkar ba/ gnyer ma cher med pa de dgos kyi/ deng song 'ga' zhig gis shum rar skye ba'i chu dag gi rtsa ba la byed pa ni rnam par 'khyams pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ go 'jo khri dpon bdud 'dul lags kyis sku bcar zhus dus shig tu/ ngas blo thog nas lam 'bras bklag dus khog phub nang phreng kha shas shig gong 'og nor 'dug khyod kyis thon dang ngas gnang ba byed ces gsungs/ de bzhin bton pas da yag po byung song gsungs shing / gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi brjod don phar zhog rjod byed kyi tshig thams cad kyang thugs la zin 'dug ces bdud 'dul sogs kyis yang yang bshad/ khro ru mkhan tshe rnam rgyun du byon nas tha snyad gtsug lag gi gnas rnams dang sngags kyi skor la bka' 'dri zhu 'dug cing/ gzhan du phebs dgos byung dus bla ma'i 53

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/mdun bka' bsgo re zhu bar mi byon pa med ces bla ma'i phyag phyi ba'i ngag las thos/ phyis gshegs dus bod bsod nams kyis ma 'chun pa ma zad/ nga rang yang long ba thang dkyil du lus pa lta bur gyur song gsungs nas thugs 'gyod chen po mdzad/ gzhan yang mkhan po tshul rgyan sogs mkhyen ldan rnams kyis phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas gang las brtsams te bka' 'dri zhus na'ang de dang de'i lan thogs med du phebs shing / mo gzigs mtshams bzhag phyin dad can tsho'i re 'dod rnams blo ston khul gyis don la mkhyen pa kho na gsungs/ de la sogs pa sgom pa la thugs gzhol bas bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa la nges pa'i shes pa skyes nas snang srid dpe char shar ba dang / ye shes kyi spyan dang mngon shes mi brjed pa'i gzungs spobs pa'i gter sogs yon tan rlabs po che la dbang 'byor pa ste/ rwa mgur las/ ngas kyang 'di nyid gcig pu ma gtogs pa/ /mdo sngags gzhan gyi thos rgya ma byas kyang / /bsgom byung shes pas gzhan rnams ma bslab shes/ /brjod bral nam mkha' lta bu'i don gcig rtogs/ /zhes dang / sde sprul kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis lam 'bras smon lam las/ tha snyad tshig gi lam la ma brten par/ /zab mo nang gi rten 'brel bsgom pa'i mthus/ /ji snyed shes bya'i gnas la ma rmongs pa'i/ khres rab klong rdol lam 'di'i khyad chos yin/ /zhes dang / 'jam mgon mi pham pas/ don la nges pa'i gdeng thob na/ /sems las chos gter 'bum phrag brdol/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ / —sngon smon rnam dkar dus su smin pa las/ /zhabs zung rin chen dang po'i 'khor lo mchog /lha ldan dag pa'i zhing du bsgyur ba na/ /dge ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma mngon par shar/ /zhabs pad gang du bkod pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /skal bzang gdul bya'i 'du ba rgyas pa'i lcid/ / 54

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/dbyig 'dzin bu mos ma theg ngal ba na/ /khyab 'jug brang 'gro nyid du brdzus sam snyam/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum gcig bsdus pa/ / rid ltar gangs ri'i mgul na mchis so zhes/ /sum rtsen yul na rgyu ba'i lha rnams kyis/ /phan tshun gleng ba'i gtam gyi sgo 'phar phyes/ /bya grub ye shes nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi/ /sde bzhi'i paklo'i tshal du 'byug pa las/ /rnam bzhi'i las kun lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul/ /dbyar gyi mtsho chen rgyas pas mtshon nus min/ /lo dang zla bar ngal ba ma dgos par/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol ba las/ /brtan g.yo'i chos kun dpe cha shar ba yis/ /ha sa badz+ra'i rnam thar khyod kyis 'dzin/ /ces bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /

dge legasa'adod 'asna'i dpe tshogs/tha mar dgongs pa rdzogs tshul/rab dmar pad+ma ra gā'i lhun po la/ /nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i dpal 'phrog pa'i/ /rdo rje'i sku mnga' badz+ra yo gi nīs/ /bde stong dbyer med rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /gsum pa gshegs nas dgongs rdzogs bsgrub pa ni/ de ltar don gnyis sgrub pa la mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po mchog gis bgrang gzhi brgyad cu gya brgyad kyi bar du las dang skal ngan gyi dbang gis sangs rgyas dang byang sems gzhan gyi gdul byar ma gyur pa'i 'gro ba mang po'i rgyud smin pa dang / bshad dang sgrub pas rgyal bsnyan rin po che'i srog 'thud de nyams med phyogs mthar spel bar mdzad/ de nas zhing 'di'i sku dngos kyi 'gro don re zhig rdzogs te yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i mtshan mar gsung 'phros kyi tshul du/ mkhyen brtse rdo rje 'chang gis bla ma chen po de tsho zhing du phebs dus sku gzugs bsrangs por mdzad nas gshegs pa mang na'ang /de tsam dgos pa mi che zhes gsungs myong zhing / nyal khar ja ma mang / 'chi khar gtam ma mang ba'i dpe ltar las ma 'das pas/ 'das khar zhal chems zer ba mang po bzhag 'dug pa la'ang phan yon cher yod pa dka' sogs kyi gsungs dwogs gzhi can 'ga' zhig byon/ me yos cho 'phrul zla ba'i mar tshes nang nas khang palisteng shod thams cad du dbyar gzhung 'dra ba'i drod chen po zhig byung zhing / sgo ra de na 56

grub dbang snyeb bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/dud khag brgyad yod pa'i sde dud res me ra lnga drug re'i nang me tog btsugs nas skye yod pa thams cad dang / sgo ra de'i khron pa'i chu bcas skam nas chu len par gzhan du 'gro dgos byung ba sogs sngon mi rabs su byung ma myong ba'i rtags dge mi dge ci rigs byung la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po dag zhing gzhan du gshegs pa na 'di lta bu'i rtags 'byung ba chos nyid yin par snang / de nas tshes nyer brgyad nang mor sku khams cung bde min lta bur mdzad pa na/ tshe stobs nas gsol sman zhig blang na zhus pas ci dgar ltos gsungs shing 'di ni gsung gi tha ma yin/ de nas zhi ba lhas/ mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims ltar/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / sngon grong khyer rtswa can du mnyam med zas gtsang sras pos seṅge'i nyal stabs shig mdzad de mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa dang mtshungs par tha ma'i gzims khri la dku g.yas pa phab nas shangs bug g.yas pa phyag g.yas pa'i srin mdzub kyis bkag ste seṅge'i gzims stabs su bzhugs shing / thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma mngon du mdzad de dus tshod gcig tsam la bzhugs/ de nas thugs rje'i gzigs pa shin tu gsal ba'i spyan zung dag rab tu zhi zhing zim bur gzigs pa'i ngang tshul gyis re zhig dgongs pa chos sku'i klong du thim par gyur to/ /de la sgom med chen po'i rtogs pa ma skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis rtogs pa'i na 'phar ba'i ched du thugs dam bzung ba yin gyi/ dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med du gyur te rtogs pa de rgyud la 'byongs pas ni 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag mi dgos pas/ dam pa 'di yang 'od gsal la ma bzhugs par gshegs song zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan rgyas par ri chos las/ tshe 'di nyid las sangs rgyas thob tshar te/ /thugs ni sangs rgyas kun dang dgongs pa mnyam/ /sgom med chen po'i rtogs pa mngon gyur pa/ /de 'dra thugs dam bzhugs pa ma yin te/ /thugs dam bzung rgyu sgrib pa sbyong rgyu dang / /sgom bya sgom byed sgom pa ci yang med/ /dper na yab sras thugs dam mi bzhugs bzhin/ /'gro ba'i don phyir sku gdung ring bsrel bzhag /phung po lhag bcas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa zer/ /zhesagasungs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sku tha 57

dge legs 'dod 'aro'i dpe tshogs/ ma'i mdzad pa bstan pa la'ang / sangs rgyas dang byang sems chen po rnams la rtag 'dzin gyi log rtog ldog nas dkon pa'i 'du shes bskyed pa dang / nad dang sdug bsngal gyi ladu shes la sogs pa bskyed de le lo can rnams chos la bskul bar bya ba sogs dgos pa khyad par can dang ldan pa yin te/ mdo sde gser 'od dam pa las/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la nga bzhugs te/ /mdo sde rin chen 'di ni 'chad mdzad kyang / /skye bo mang po 'di dag bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' ba'ang ston par mdzad/ /byis pa lta ba log par gyur pa rnams/ /nga yi bstan la mos pa mi byed pa/ /de dag kun tu bsgral ba'i don gyi phyir/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' ba'ang ston mdzad do/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar ro/ / khro ru mkhan po tshe rnam mchog nas gdung la bum chu'i rgyun gyis khrus gsol dang / de nas mkhan po la tshe stobs dang ral ru rdor don gnyis kyis zhabs 'degs zhus te/ gdung rin po cher byi dor dang chas zhugs kyi rim pa bcas legs par zhus nas mchod pa'i rnam grangs mang pos bkur sti dang bcas khri la mnga' gsol zhing / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gis gtsos rten khyad par can bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams su mchod 'bul dang / sa ngor sogs dgon sde khag tu tshogs bsngo/ dgung zhag ma tshang bar zhal slob rnams nas mkha' spyod sogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te gdung mchod 'bul ba bcas dang / sku tsha dkon mchog tshe dbang nas bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs su dmigs te 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa bsags mdzad pas tshar chig stong lhag ljags klog grub 'dug pa sogs gshegs rjes dgongs rdzogs kyang rgya cher bsgrubs par mdzad/ grub dbang dam pa de nyid zhing du gshegs 'phral nas khro ru ba tshe rnam mchog gis gshegs rtsis sku gdung bca' gsham bya tshul dang bcas pa zhig bkod gnang ba 'di ltar te/ gshegs rtsis sku gdung bca' gshom bya tshul dang bcas pa bzhugs/ bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i shākya'i dge slong brtsi bya lcags byi dgung phreng gya brgyad steng phebs pa mchog me yos cho 'phrul zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi tshes 28res 58

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/gza' pa sangs nyin gyi snga dre'i chu tshod 9 40thog dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan par skyes bu dam pa gang zag khyad par can la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mnga' zhing 'dur rtsis mi dgos mod/ 'jig rten khams kyi thun mong gi snang ngor rnam rtog rags pa sel byed tsam du da lam 'dur rtsis bskor ba'i 'bras bu las/ sku'i bla sngon shing lo 'dab rgyas kyi dus dben gnas rnying par gdon bgegs nub nas 'ongs te khyer/ mi mang 'du longs che ba dang / rlung dmar ldang pa/ nyams zas mchod pa gang rung gis lan/ sku sgog rgyal pos bcad/ zhag nyer drug nas pha khu rgan rgas la zlos/sbrum ldan bud med lnga la ngan pas bzlog thabs kyi gto rim du/ shar gyi phyogs nas rdo ljang nar mo zhig bzhes te phyag rgya rdzu rnga—ṇ+ḍa1snyeridi sbyar ba dang / rta sbrul gyi mgo bo zhig bcos pa'am bris pa sku gdung steng 'jog mdzo rtol la dar zab bkal la dur kha bcag lo rta glang lug sprul bcas yod na sku gdung la blta reg mi rung ba yin/ mdun chos gtsug tor dkar nag dang / nyi khri/ sa bdag 'brugs gto/sher snying bdud bzlog sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum bcas gsung sgrogs zhu/ sku gdung la bca' gshom mdzad dgos pa ni/ 'dur rtsis las/ nyan thos btsun pa'i pur la ni/ /pur khang legs par brtsigs nas kyang / /chos gos khung du dril nas ni/ /thang shing bu dang shug pas bsregs/ /mchod pa rgyas pa 'bul bar bya/ /gdung rus swāts+tsha btab nas kyang / /mchod rten nang du bzhugs su gsol/ /nyan thos 'dul khrims dag pa'i dur/ /'dul ba 'dzin pa rgyun mi chad/ /ces gsungs pa dang / yang de nyid las/ rnal 'byor nyams len ldan pa yis/ /bcos min thugs dam bzhugs pa rnams/ /ma grol bar du spang bar bya/ gces 'dzin yon tan ldan pa'i tshogs/ /zhag bdun 'das nas gtong ba gces/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sku gdung rin po cher bud med dang / zhus bu/ khyi sogs dam nyams sdig can gyis lag reg tu mi 'jug pa'i thog thugs dam la bzhugs min sku gdung gi babs la gzigs nas sku gdung la kha che gur gum sogs dri bzang pos legs par byugs te pur dar zab kyis gril zhing gding ba bting la chos gos rnam gsum bsgron nas seṅge'i gzims 59

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/zhig bzhengs shing / rnam dkar dge ba'i phyogs kyi thugs dgongs rnams bsgrubs nas 'bad par gyur na/ phyi ma dge slong zhig tu sku'i skye ba bzhes par 'gyur ba yin no zhes bslu med gtsug lag gzhung las gsungs so/ /zhes so/ /sngon skyabs rje nyid zhal bzhugs dus kyi bka' bkod bzhin bla ma zhing du gshegs palimi snyan pa'i gnas tshul de cha 'phrin gyi lam du btang bas/ de nyid 'di yod kyi skya ser rnams kyi rna bar lhung ste mya ngan gyis yid gdung par gyur/ sku gdung rin po che rang yul du spyan drangs rgyu la thugs mthun te su 'gro gleng ba'i tshe/ dge mkhyen rab dpal ldan dang kun mchog bstan 'dzin gnyis ma bskul dang blang gis 'gro bar khas len bud de khong gnyis dang lha sa nas sku dbon dkon mchog tshe dbang dang bcas khong gsum gyis gdung rang yul gyi bsod nams kyi zhing du gdan drangs shing / dgon du nye bar 'byor pa dang lha bsang ser sbreng gis bsu ba bcas bgyis te lha sar khang du bzhugs su gsol/ skya ser kun gyis gdung mjal dang mchod 'bul khas len bcas yid tshim par zhus/ mthar zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes dge bar dgon pa'i nub phyogs bkag nags mchod rten du btegs te mkha' spyod kyi slob dpon ye na mchog sprul ngag dbang phun tshogs don 'grub dang / kye rdor gyi slob dpon mkhan po seṅge rgyal mtshan/ kun rig gi slob dpon mkhan po mkhyen brtse snying po bcas kyis mdzad de gdung zhugs 'bul mdzad/ (kho bo yang de nyin ma rgan gyis khrid de gdung me mchod phul ba mjal skal thob cing da ltar gsal po dran lam du 'dug mchan)/ de skabs su gnam gshis bzang zhing nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i ngos nas 'ja' sprin gyis kheng pa sogs ltas ya mtshan pa du ma byung / gdung khang zhal phyes tshe srid pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du bstan 'gro'i don la gang 'dul sprul sku'i rol pas ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs/ zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor/ brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs pa'i brda la thugs ljags spyan gsum me yis ma bzhes par bzhugs pa dang / gdung rus sogs las bsod nams kyi rten du sha ri ram shas che ba'i ring bsrel yang mtha' yas par byon/dgon gzhung nas bla ma mchog gi thugs ljags spyan gsum dang / zhal 'don/ phyag phreng sogs 61

dge legaga'adod 'do'i dbe tshogs/bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gser dngul las grub pa rin chen du ma'i phra rgyan can mi tshad ma zhig bzhengs pa dang / bla ma mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad pa can gyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo tshe ring stobs ldan nas sku rgyu gser zangs las grub cing dus rabs gang du bzhengs ma nges pa/ bum pa zlum zhing zi'u lha khang med pa/ nang gzungs su bla ma mchog gi rten sgam du srid na rnyed par dka' ba'i rten gyi rigs bzhugs so cog phul ba'i mchod rten khru gsum pa can zhig bla ma'i gdung rten gyi phyir du lcags 'brug lor rang dgon du phul ba ste/ de gnyis ka'ang mchod rdzas mang pos mdun brdar te lha gsar khang du bzhugs su gsol/ sngar bla ma mchog nyid zhal bzhugs skabs su rang pang kheb can gyi bud med cig la thim pa'i snang ba shar ba na sems bde ba'i ngang du 'byams pa zhig byung bas/ ngazhi yang srid de bod mo zhig la skye ba 'dra zhes tshe stobs la phebs pa ltar yang sprul rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sde dge'i gling tshang ba zhig la byon cing / da ltar gzhung lugs la gsan bsam dang smin grol gdams pa'i skor mang por bzhes bzhin du bzhugs pa yin la/ slad mar dam pa'i yon tan gang gi thad nas rje gong ma'i rnam thar la 'gran bzod pa zhig 'byon rgyu la gus 'dud dang bcas snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags so/ /gzod nas skye med rdo rje'i sku brnyes kyang / /gdul bya'i don du gzugs sku'i bsil byed mchog /skye 'chi rang dbang thob pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ /re zhig zhing 'di'i nub ri'i phag tu yib/ /mkha' las byung ba'i chu 'dzin mkha' nyid la/ /dengs pa ji bzhin gang gi gsang ba gsum/ /gang las sprul palisprul gzhi'i dgongs klong du/ /slar yang dbyer med ro gcig gyur 'dis skyo/ /62

grub dbang thub bsnyan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/'on kyang ji srid 'khor ba ma stong bar/ /sna tshogs sprul pas 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /bzod ldan sangs rgyas spyi yi tshul yin phyir/ /ri mgon de'i thugs rje dus yol ci phyir srid/ /de bas ngag la dbang bsgyur sa skya pa'i/ /lung rtogs bstan pa yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dri med bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ /mchod pa'i skal bzang shar la su zhig tshom/ /de phyir gang gi 'phrin las gaṅgā ma/ /mtha' yas skye dgu'i yid kyi zhing sa mā /thugs bskyed dza hu na yis skyugs pa'i mthus/ /phan dang bde ba'i lo tog ci yang rgyas/ /zhes bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /slar smras pa/rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter/ /mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes kyi rnam pa mā /yongs shar khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po de'i/ /zhabs la bde chen 'khor los slar yang gtug /gang gis thos bsam bsgom pa'i gru chen las/ /rnam grol mi gnas thar pa'i gling mchog tu/ /mngon par gshegs pa'i sngon byung ngo mtshar gtam/ /63

dge legasa'adod 'do'i dpe tshogs/dus 'dir nub la nye tshe bdag yid phangs/ /de slad khyod kyi 'phrin las bskyangs pa yi/ /chos grwa 'di la me rtag phog pa las/ /tshul 'di 'bri ba'i bsod nams nor gyi lcid/ /bdag gi phrag tu babs 'dis spro ba brtas/ /de lta na yang zab cing rgya che ba'i/ /rgyal ba'i mdzad pa chu gter chen po'i mtha' /'phags pa slob pa'i grus kyang bgrod dka' na/ /bdag blo byis pa'i rkyal gyis bgrod thabs bral/ /de phyir 'di la nyes pa ci mchis pa/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig lhung dang / /chab gcig sras bcas rgyal ba'i mdun 'chags na/ / bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /legs byas 'od zer stong gi drwa ba yis/ /'byud pa'i dge tshogs ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzis/ /snyigs ma rnam lnga'i mun pa mthar byas te/ /phan bde kun+da'i dga' tshal rgyas gyur cig /dge legs bye ba'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan/ /skye 'gro'i bsod nams zhing du gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rnams/ /phun tshogs dbyar mtsho ji bzhin 'phel gyur cig /64

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/bdag gis bla med byang chub sgrub pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi zhing / /log 'tshos dben pa'i mthun rkyen kun tshang nas/ /tshe chos sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par shoga'ajigs rung mtha' med 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho na/ /sdug bsngal na kras gtses pa'i 'gro ba kun/ / gtan bde bla med stobs bcu mnga' ba'i sar/ /'dren pa'i ded dpon chen po bdag gyur cig /bla ma lha yi thugs rje'i byin rlabs dang / /tha snyad rten 'byung bslu ba med pa dang / /bdag gis dad pas sbyar ba'i dge ba'i mthus/ /smon pa'i don kun gegs med myur 'grub shog /bkra shis gang zhig byams dang snying rje'i sems/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rgyud la ngang gis skyes/ /phan tshun gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor bral/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog /ces 'dren mchog bla ma dam pa grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas mchog gi rnam par thar pa thar 'dod bung ba 'gugs pa'i skyed tshal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yul gang la 'gro ba bzhi yi chos las 'da' ba'i dad pa dang ldan cing / mgon po gang gi slob brgyud du gtogs pa'i rigs pa smra ba rab brtan dge legs phun tshogs sam ming gzhan la nyi ma blo gsal du 'bod pa'i snyigs dus kyi dge sbyong dregs po des/ sngar rang lo nyi shu'i steng son dus bris pa'i rnam thar la gzhir bzung / slar rdo rje'i bu 65

tsha du ma las ji ltar thos pa rnams kyis gsal bar byas te sgro bkur gyi mtha' dang bral bar/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing bya lo'i smal po zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa bla chen chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che zhing du gshegs pa'i dus dran la dgon chen mdzes phu bshad grwa chen mo'i rang shag tu mjug rdzogs par sbyar ba'i dge bas skyabs rje gang gis rjes su bzung zhing khyed kyi rjes su slob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o/

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/gdung rten mthong grol chen mo'i nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag mdor bsdus su bkad pa bzhugs sa/ /phyi ltar sdom brtson yongs kyi gtso/ /nang ltar rgyal sras sems dpa' che/ /gsang ba he ru kaḥdapal dngos/ /thub bstan 'phel rgyas zhabs la 'dud/ /de la bla ma rwa chen rdo rje grags pa'i sgyu 'phrul du bsngags pa'i me tog gtor ba/ mthu stobs nus pa'i dpal mnga' mkhan chen thub bstan 'phel rgyas mchog mya ngan las 'das pa'i gdung rten gyi tshul du/ zla bral bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo rgan tshe ring stobs ldan nas nyams gso gang dgos gnang thog rje btsun bla ma mchog gi thugs dam gyi rten rnams dang / khyad par dam pa nyid kyi rten sgam du ring bsrel gyi rigs bzhugs so cog sogs byin rlabs zab mo'i drod ma yal zhing / srid na thob par dka' ba'i rten gyi rnam grangs ches mang ba zhig bzhugs su gsol nas gdan sa rab brtan dgon du phul ba'i mchod sdong mthong grol chen mo'i nang bzhugs kyi dkar chag mdor bsdus su 'bri ba la rten gsum sogs kyi skor dang / ring bsrel gyi skor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bla ma mchog nas thugs dam gyi rten du mdzad pa'i sa chen gong ma rnam lnga dang / kye rdor/ bde mchog mkha' spyod/ 'jigs byed ma he gcig gur mgon bcas kyi sku dang / khra rig rin po che'i thugs dam rten gyi mgon po'i sku/67

dge legs 'dod 'azho'i dpe tshogs/mkhan chen nyid kyi gdung dzus las bzhengs pa'i sa paṇa dang / 'jigs byed kyi sku/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi gzungs grwa lnga'i rgya dpe/ 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi gter ma gsang bdag be con dam grib nyes pa kun sel/ jo bo rje'i phyag tshwa/ gung thang sgrol ma lte khang gi mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi nang rdzas sne mang / jo bo dang khra 'brug sgrol ma nyer gcig gi nang bzhugs zhabrul med/ mchod rten bya rung kha shor gyi srog shing / pad+ma bkod 'gro 'dul gling pa'i gter ma si: ra/ rje btsun bir wa pa nas brgyud pa'i sa ngor rim byon gyi rten 'dus khyad 'phags/ ngor lugs dkyil 'khor bdun gyi dkyil bye/thang rgyal dngos kyi tshe ril/ kame pa'i ril nag bdun/ khri dar lung ma gcig sogs rten gsum dang sngar gyi rten khyad can 'ga' yi nang rdzas bcas legs par bzhugs/ gnyis pa ring bsrel gyi skor la bzhi las/ dang po yung 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel la/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring bsrel dang / stag mo lus spyin gyi ring bsrel bdun/ wā ra ṇa sī'i ring bsrel sogs yung 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel mang por bzhugs/ gnyis pa sku gdung gi ring bsrel la/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i gdung rus ril bu dang / mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i gdung rus ril bu/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi rkang rus ril bu/ gu ru chos dbang gi gdung rus/ smin gling gter bdag gling pa'i gdung rus/ smin gling lo chen gyi gdung rus/grub chen nā ro ta pa'i gdung rus ril bu/ mar pa lo tswa'i phyag mdzub/ rje btsun mi la'i gdung rus/ pha dam pa'i gdung rus/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi dbu thod ril bu bdun/ sa chen kun dga' snying po'i gdung rus ril bu/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i dbu thod ril bu/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po'i gdung tshwa dang gdung rus ril bu/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong gi sku sha/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po'i gdung rus ril bu/ 'ardzam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i gdung tshwa/ mkhan rgan bsam gtan blo gros kyi gdung rus/ grub dbang bla ma nyid kyi gdung rus/ rje blo bzang grags pa'i gdung rus/ yar lung ban tshang nas byung ba'i skye bdun sku sha zhabrul med sogs gdung rus dang gdung tshwa sku sha bcas sne mang bzhugs su gsol/ gsum pa sku bal gyi ring bsrel la/ yar lung shel brag gi nang rten du rgya

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyasakyi rnam thar/gar nas spyan drangs pa'i gu ru shākya seṅge'i chos gos dang / lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi gter ma gu ru'i dbu lo/ stag mo lus sbyin gyi stag lpags/ khra 'brug 'brong btsan lha khang nas byon pa'i srong btsan sgam po'i na bza'/ mnga' bdag nyang ral gyi dbu skra/ rgyal ba klong chen pa'i na bza'/ gnam chos mi 'gyur mi 'gyur rdo rje'i na bza'/ 'gro mgon chos 'phags kyi dbu zhwa/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi dbu zhwa/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i na bza' sogs dbu lo na bza' byin chen mang du bzhugs/ bzhi pa chos sku'i ring bsrel la/ bla ma brgyud pa rim byon gyi mtshan sngags dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags/ 'od zer dri med dang / gtsug tor rnam rgyal/gtsug tor dri med/ gsang ba ring bsrel/ rten 'brel snying po ste gzungs chen sde lnga phon chen sogs mtshan gzungs kyi rigs grangs mang legs 'bul zhus shing / ma 'ong 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi zhing mchog tu bzhugs pa'i mchod sdong 'di nyid mjal skor mchod phyag bgyis pa'i phan yon sogs ni/gzhung gzhan las 'byung ba bzhin shes par bya ba las 'dir mang kyis dwogs nas ma spros so/ /skye dgu'i dge legs 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bla na med pa'i mchod sdong che/ /mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba kun/ /don gnyis phun sum tshogs par shog /ces pa'ang mchod sdong mthong grol chen mo'i nang gzungs bskyar phul skabs kyi zin tho bzhin rab dgon bla ma dz+nyā na'i mtshan can gyis mchod sdong gi dkar chag dang phan yon bcas bkod mdzad par go rim gsar du bsgrigs te mdor bsdus su rab brtan dge legs phun tshogs pas sbyar ba bsod nams kyi tshogs chen rdzogs pa'i rgyur gyur cig/69

dge legasa'adod 'aro'i dpe tshogs/gsol 'debs byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bcud gter/༄7//'dren mchog rje btsun rnal 'byor che//grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi//rnam thar gsol 'debs su bkod pa//byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bcud ster bzhugs//na mo gu ru badz+ra dhā rā ya/khyab bdag thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po//bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du yongs shar ba/gzhan don 'phrin las 'phel zhing rgyas pa can//'dren mchog chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs//mgon po khyod ni sngon nas byang chub kyang //skal ldan gdul bya'i sems rgyud gtsang ma'i mtshor//gang 'dul ye shes bkod pa 'byams klas pa/rgyun chad med par ston la gsol ba 'debs//khyad par 'phags yul gtsug lag dpal dge dang //70 la stod snye nam rwa chen rdo rje grags//

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/nā len+d+ra dang go che'i sprul sku sogs/ /sku phreng rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ / — gzig sgang grong du rab tshes lcags byi lor/ / byams pa bkra 'tsho gnyis kyi rigs sras su/ /phru mas chos gos gsol ba'i tshul dang bcas/ /bsam bzhin srid pa bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /chung nas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad de/ /ma gyur 'gro la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang / /srid las nges par 'byung ba'i skyo shas sogs/ /rtsol med ngang gis 'brungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgung grangs bdun par dgon gyi tshogs la zhugs/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' rgyal mtshan las/ /dge bsnyen dang ni rab byung sdom pa bzhes/ /bslab khrims gces par srung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas dam pa'i che ba la/ /gzhan dang 'thab tshe me stag 'phro ba dang / /stobs dang rtsal gyis phas rgol zil gyis gnon/'gran gyi do zla med la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcu bdun pa la ngor du grwa sar phebs/'ardzam dbyangs thub bstan chos kyi rgyal mtshan las/ /bsnyen par rdzogs te thub bstan 'phel rgyas zhes/ /71

dge legasa'adod 'aro'i dpe tshogs/mtshan gyi cod pan gsol la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang 'dren mchog thar rtse rje de las/ /dpal ldan bi ru pa yi thugs kyi bcud/ /gsung ngag lam 'bras tshogs bshad la sogs pa'i/ /zab chos rgya cher gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dbon stod mkhyen rab chos kyi 'od zer dang / /a dpal la sogs yongs 'dzin du ma las/ /mdo sngags gzhung chen mang po gsan mdzad de/ /thos pa'i pha mthar son la gsol ba 'debs/ /'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi blo gros kyi/ /zhabs pad spyi bo'i gtsug tu gus mchod de/ /lam 'bras sgrub btus gdams ngag mdzod la sogs/ /smin grol gdams mang bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /sga ston rdo rje 'chang dang 'jam rgyal zhabs/ / kun bzang chos 'phel hor bla la sogs las/ /lam 'bras rnam 'grel gur zhal chos skor sogs/ /yab chos rdzogs par nos la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub mchog ngag dbang bsam gtan blo gros kyis/ /'jigasatshobyed khang du sbyin sreg blug pa'i tshe/ /dgongs rgyud rtogs pa 'pho ba'i tshul bstan te/ /rgyal tshab mnga' gsol mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /72

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/gzhan yang 'jam dpal khros pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /bcugs te gdams chos lhag lus med pa bstsal/ /rten der dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa yi/ /lung bstan dbugs dbyung gnang la gsol ba 'debs/ /de skabs mi ma yin pas legs skyes su/ /rin chen dang po'i khem bu mdun du phul/ /de nyid bla ma mnyes pa'i mchod sprin du/ /spros te rten 'brel dge la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na rnam 'dren bcu phrag du ma las/ /smin grol gdams pa'i zab chos mang bzhes te/ /gang thugs zab cing yangs pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /lung rtogs nor gyis gtams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'phred mo bde chen ltem dang dgon nang du/ / bzhugs nas mkha' kye rta phyag thams cad rig /tshe sgrub 'jigs byed brag rdzong ma sogs kyi/ /bsnyen sgrub rtags thon mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma'i bka' bzhin bgrang bya bcu'i ring la/ /dbyar gnas dang ni slob grwa'i mkhan po mdzad/ /mdo sngags rig gzhung rgya mtsho'i bshad pa dang / /smin grol zab chos bstsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog gzig sgang ri khrod du/ /73

dge legasa'adod 'do'i daspre tshogs/thog mar 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i mtshams bzhugasate/ /snying po yi ge bcu pa dung phyur gcig / ciljags thog bsags par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshams las grol tshe dus dgra'i dbang po che/ /gshin rje gshed dang dbyer med dngos lta bu'i/ /gsal snang byung zhing rigs kyi bdag pos kyang / /de ltar yang yang gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang 'jam mgon bla ma'i mdun du phebs/ /gsar rnying dang 'brel bka' chos mang du bzhes/ /de tshe bum chu bdud rtsi zho ltar chags//bla mar rgyal bar gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par sa byi'i mchu zla'i bco lnga la/ /ched du thub bstan di med 'od zer zhes/ /mtshan gyi prog zhur gsol dang chabs gcig tu/ /byang chub sems sdom bstsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzhan yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal dang / /sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs kyi/ /dus grangs rtags kyi bsnyen pa them par mdzad/ /sgrub pa'i bstan pa spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhan chen mkhyen rab rje dang yon tan mtshan/ /dgon gyi dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs sogs la/ /74

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/'jigs byed rwa lugs lha dgu'i smin grol dang / /lam 'bras rnam 'grel bstsal la gsol skre 'debs/ /dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen du/sgrol ma gsung byon grags pa'i sku mdun nas/ /theg chen byang chub sems sdom bzhes pa'i tshe/phyag rten mgul dar bsgron la gsol la 'debs/ /bstan pa srung ba'i dam can srung ma la/ /bstan dgra sgrol bar ma bskul bzhin du yang / /bstan la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i srog dbugs 'phrog /bstan srung bran du 'khor la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdud kyi rigs kyis bkyes pa'i cho 'phrul ches/ /tshugs par med par gcig char brlags shing stor/ /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum dang dbyer med du/ /bzhugs pa'i dus dgra'i dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /klu mchod mdzad dus klu yis gus phyag bcas/ /gang bcol 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i dam bca' phul/ /gter bum byin pa'i bka' drin mtshon byed du/ /chu gter phul bar byung la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan dang 'gro la 'tshe ba'i las ngan rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab zab mos rgyas btab ste/ /rwa lo'i drag chen sgo nas gnas spar zhing / / 75

dge legs 'dod 'do'i dpe tshogs/bka' dam bzhag par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /de skabs nam mkha' bar snang rgyan chad cing / /ye shes me 'bar khrag gi rgyun chen 'khyil/ /thab kyi rdul tshon bkrag yal bral ba sogs/ /sprul sgyur thogs pa med la gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par gshed bzlog tshe na rlung nag 'tshubs/ /ling gas 'phar g.yo dang ni cho nge 'debs/ /nyin mtshan med par 'o dod 'bod pa sogs/ /ngo mtshar gzigs mo ston la gsol ba 'debs/ /skabs 'gar 'jam dpal khros pa'i skur bzhengs te/ /misprosun pa yi nag phyogs bdud kyi sde/ /zhabs 'og brdzis nas srog gi snying po blangs/ /phyag zhabs rjes mang bzhag la gsol ba 'debs/ /mngon gyur mngon sum tshad mas gzhal ba ltar/ /gang zhig gang gis bskal ba'i chos thams cad/ /thogs par med par gzigs pa'i spyan dang ldan/ /mngon shes stsol med mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma bzhugs pa'i phyogs kyi dud 'gro yang / /'jig rten 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /'ja' 'od gur phub 'od zer 'phro ba sogs/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan la gsol ba 'debs/ /76

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/nang du rim gnyis rtogs tshad mthon por gshegs/ /phyi ru rdo rje'i yul khams rnams su bgrod/ /gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang spyod pa spyad/ /rtogs pa'i dbang phyug chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshungs med lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid che/ /mkhan chen mkhyen rab chos rje'i spyan snga nas/zag med rab dga'i sa la gnas so zhes/ /bden gsung me tog gtor la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgrub pa mdzad par sngon nas dbus phyogs su/ /phebs 'dun yod kyang bshol te re zhig bzhugs/ /de nas lha dang bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ /dbus su phebs grabs mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /byon khar mgon khang bdud dpung zil gnon du/ /bskang bzlog bshags 'phrin drag tu mdzad pa'i tshe/ /ye shes mgon pos mjal phyag rten du bzhag /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bor gsol ba 'debs/ /lam du chom pos 'tshe ba byung ba'i tshe/ /srung mas mi 'dod cho 'phrul mang du bstan/ /rku rdzas phyir phul bshags pa rgya cher byas/ /srung mas 'phrin las bsgrubs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha sa 'phan yul bsam yas zhes kha dre(gas/ /77

dge legs 'dod 'jo'i dpe tshogs/dbus gtsang dgon gnas rnams la mjal bskor dang / /phyag mchod bsnyen bkur thugs dam nyams bzhes bcas/ /thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /nag ngo 'i phyogs kyi 'tshub 'gyur snang ba'i tshe/ /thugs stobs brtson paligo cha cher bgos te/ /snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i rgud pa'i mun pa bsal/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /tshe smad lha ldan sprul pa'i zhing khams su/ /bzhugs nas bdag gzhan don gnyis mtha' dra khyan/ /rab brtan mkhan po zhes pa'i grags pas khyab /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon bzang por gsol ba 'debs/ /gzungs dang spobs pa'i gter la mnga' dbang 'byor/ /sde snod rgyud sde'i tshig don thugs la mnga' /yin min dogs pa'i the tshom drwa ba bsal/ /mkhyen pa'i gter chen khyed la gsol ba 'debs/mtho dman med par skal ldan gdul bya la/ /gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i lam bstan nas/ /mos ldan 'gro ba'i re ba yid bzhin skong / /thugs rje'i dbang phyug che la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdzas sngags dmigs pa'i sbyor ba zab mo yis/ /bdud bgegs kyis gtses spyo lkugs brgyal ba dang / /78

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/'byung bzhi'i 'jigs pa mi dmigs dbyings su bskrad/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyun du rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor las/ /nam yang g.yel med drod tshad mngon du gyur/ / nyin mtshan mnyam rjes bral ba'i nyams rtogs 'char/ /zhabrul zhig rnal 'byor chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na 'phags bod paṇa grub thams cad kyi/ /mkhas tshul btsun tshugs grub pa'i rtags mtshan dang / /bzang po'i spyod pa ma lus khyod la rdzogs/ /kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs/ /tha mar re zhig gdul bya rdzogs gyur te/ /zhing khams gzhan du dgongs pa gtad pa na/ /drod kyis khengs shing me tog chu bcas yal rgyal sras sems dpa' che la gsol ba 'debs/ /gung grangs bcu phrag brgyad dang nyag ma brgyad/ /bzhes pa me yos mchu zla'i nyer brgyad la/ /ting 'dzin du ma'i sgo rnams mngon du mdzad/ /gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus la gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams rten du sku gdung ring bsrel bzhag /zhugs la phul tshe nam mkha' dwangs shing gsal/ /phyogs rnams kun tu 'ja' sprin drwa bas khengs/ /79

dge legs 'dod 'asna'i dpe tshogs/ngo mtshar ltas mang mnga' la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis snang spros pa'i mtshan ma ma lus pa/ /chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig byang chub ste/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa yi/ /bla ma chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las g.yo med kyang / /sa bcu dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs rnams dang / /gsang chen rdo rje'i chos la longs spyod pa'i/ /bla ma longs spyod rdzogs skur gsol ba 'debs/ /slar yang srid pa gsum du srid mtha'i bar/ /gang 'dul mdzad pa'i khyad par 'byams klas pas/ /sna tshogs gdul bya 'dul la thabs mkhas pa/ /bla ma sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar 'dren mchog dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /rnam thar phyogs tsam thos shing dran pas kyang /mi ldog rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dad thob ste/ /sgo gsum rab gus dwangs bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag lus longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs dang / /'jig rten mkho dgu'i yo byad ci mchis pa/ /blo yis blangs nas bla ma sras bcas la/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du sprul te mchod/ / 80

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/thog med dus nas bdag gis las nyon dang / /rgyu bzhi'i dbang gis kha na ma tho ba/ /bgyis dang bgyid rtsal bgyis la yi rang ba/ /thams cad gnong zhing 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags/ /mgon po khyed kyi gsang gsum yon tan dang / /bsam yas 'phrin las kyis getsos 'gro kun gyi/ /dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag la/ /phrag dog 'gran sems med pas rjes yi rang / /bdag sogs snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba rnams/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las skyabs pa'i phyir/ /dad phyag dang bcas ji tsam bzod pa yi/ /legs gsung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /dang po'i dus kyi thugs bskyed la dgongs nas/ /'jig rten mtha' dag mchog tu zhi ba'i bar/ /ngo mtshar bkod pas 'gro don mdzad bzhin du/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum bsags pa'i legs byas che/ /'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i rtsis bran te/ /rje btsun dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /ma gyur 'gro bas byang chen thob phyir bsngo/ /༈mtshungs med rje btsun rnal 'byor chen po la/ /81

dge legasa'adod 'do'i daspre tshogs/zol med dad pas snying nas gsol 'debs na/ /sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis nyer gzigs nas/ /'dzad med byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par shog /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i ma dag sems can rnams/ /ji srid 'khor bar 'khyams pa de srid du/ /mi rtag 'chi ba dran pas rgyud bskul te/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor don yod byed par shog /'jig rten mtha' dag duḥkha'i rang bzhin can/ /de kun zag bcas las nyon las byung bar/ /mthong nas nges 'byung skyo shas skye ba dang / /las 'bras blang dor tshul bzhin byed par shog /bka' drin che ba'i yongs 'dzin du ma las/ /mdo rgyud rig gzhung rgya mtshor mkhas byas te/ /dus kun 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba dang / /tshul bzhin sgrub la brtson pas 'da' bar lhasnag /de tshe bla ma lha yi thugs bskyed kyis/ /mi mthun rgud tshogs mtha' dag yongs zhi nas/ /zas skom la sogs rke1na pas bsngags pa yi/ /mthun rkyen dka' tshegs med par rnyed par lha/ga /'jig rten tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /mgon po khyod nyid gang du bzhugs pa yi/ /82

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/gnas der skyes nas gus pas nyer bsten te/ /zab rgyas dam pa'i chos kyis 'tsho bar shog /gal te zhing der skyes par ma gyur nas/ /rnam shes bar ma do ru 'khyams gyur na/ / de tshe dpa' bo mkha' 'gros sngon bsus te/ /rig 'dzin dag pa'i grong du khrid par shog /bdag tu 'dzin pas 'khor bar skyes gyur kyang / /dal 'byor rten thob mtshan ldan bshes dang mjal/ /tshul khrims rnam par dag pas rgyud bsdams te/ /zhi bde'i ded dpon gcig tu 'gyur bar shog /mdor na byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /khyod kyi brtse chen lcags kyus yongs bzung ste/ /rnam dag theg chen chos dang mi 'bral bar/ /rgyal sras byang chub spyod la gzhol bar 31ga /nam zhig rdo rje 'dzin sa brnyes nas kyang / /dpag bsam shing ltar rnam rtog med bzhin du/ / sku dang 'phrin las rgyun chad med pa yis/mtha' klas 'gro ba'i don chen byed par shog /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs rje'i nus stobs dang / /stong dang rten 'byung bslu ba med pa dang / /bdag gi dad blo dung ltar dkar ba'i mthus/ /83

dge legs 'dod 'aro'i dpe tshogs/smon pa'i don kun de bzhin 'grub par shog /de skad rab brtan shu snye lagh+ri pas/ /dam pa'i 'byung gnas dgon chen bshad grwa rtswa / shing bya mgo zla'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ / sbyar ba'i dge bas byang chen myur thob shog /sarba maṅga lam/ dge'o// //

grub dbang thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi rnam thar/mkhan chen thub bstan 'phel rgyas kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ /oṃ su sti/ thub bstan mdo sngags chos kyi rgya mtsho che/ / mi nyams 'phel zhing rgyas shing mthu grub pa/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs kyis brten pa'i gnas/ /bshes gnyen klu yi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi ltar gnas brtan ngur smig 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /nang ltar 'gro la brtse ba'i khur chen bzhes/ /gsang ba dgyes mdzad lha dang mi gnyis pa'i/ /sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gsol ba 'debs/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i khrims kyi rtsa ba brtan/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i kho lag yangs/ /smin grol zab mo'i 'bras bu'i g.yur za ba'i/bshes gnyen dpag bsam dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'phrin las rgyas gyur cig /ces pa'ang mched grogs zung gis bskul ngor ban de mu ne+e'i ming gis gsol ba btab pa'o/ /85

masdokyig gi gtam/mtshungs med rje btsun bla ma mchog la mi phyed pa'i dad 'dun mnga' ba'i zla bral bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen mo sga pa tshe ring stobs ldan mchog yum sras rnams nas grub dbang bla ma rin po che la zhabs tog bsnyen bkur dpag med bsgrubs mdzad par ma zad/ da lan yang 'dren mchog gang gi rnam thar gyi deb 'di'i 'gro gron gyi ma dngul yongs rdzogs ma bskul dang blang gis gnang ba la snying thag pa nas yi rang zhu rgyu dang 'brel/ gang gi zhabs pad brtan cing tshe bsod chos nor dbang klung yar zla ltar rgyas nas gang bzhed lhun gyis 'grub pa'i gsol smon 'dun pa rtse gcig tu zhu ba dang bcas gus rtsom sgrig pa rab brtan dge ming pas me phag zla 2tshes 5dge ba la/
